descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate, infrastructure, private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM.

Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on lower mid market European buyout investments, raising over €430m. The fund operates out of London and focuses on investments in founder and family owned companies in B2B Services and Education across the UK and the DACH regions.

Your role

As part of a team of 12 professionals, you will be responsible for Investor Relations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Building and maintaining working relationships with Pictet's Wealth Management (PWM) relationship managers and Asset Management (PAM) sales staff across the network, understanding their client books, distribution priorities, and the broader Pictet product shelf;

• Proactively identifying and developing relationships with Limited Partners (LPs) and co-investment prospects — leveraging existing relationships within Pictet to do so;
• Runing a regular engagement calendar of product briefings, market updates, Q&A sessions, and bilateral meetings with distribution partners and LPs;
• Managing LP relationships through the full fund cycle — from first meeting through commitment, onboarding, ongoing reporting, and re-ups;
• Knowing the portfolio in sufficient depth to hold detailed investor conversations on any company without requiring a member of the senior investment team to be present;
• Owning all investor-facing materials — pitch deck, DDQ, LP updates, fund profile — working closely with PAA Marketing and Communications to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with PAA brand guidelines;
• Maintaining DealCloud as the primary record of LP relationships and pipeline; use AI tools (Claude, Copilot) in materials drafting, research, competitor tracking, and preparation.

Your profile

• Minimum 7 years' experience in investor relations, product specialist, or distribution within private equity, private credit, or private markets;
• Direct experience working with private banking or wealth management distribution channels and managing LP relationships through the full fund cycle;
• Financially literate — able to discuss fund performance, portfolio company financials, and return attribution with confidence;
• Experience with DealCloud or a comparable CRM platform will be preferred; strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, accurate investor-grade documents is required.
• Credible with senior counterparts — PWM bankers, institutional allocators, and private clients; builds rapport naturally, follows through consistently, and navigates a multi-boutique, multi-stakeholder environment effectively
• Genuinely passionate about private equity and the underlying investment strategy, with the ability to convey the investment story with conviction to clients and prospects; French language capability preferred but not required.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 sedi in centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, e attualmente impiega oltre 5200 persone. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone. FundPartner Solutions offre una suite completa di servizi di gestione fondi e private label. Il team globale di esperti del settore si specializza nella domiciliazione dei fondi, registrazione e governance, così come nel rispetto dei rischi e nei servizi di gestione degli investimenti. Le operazioni forniscono un trattamento sicuro ed efficiente delle transazioni bancarie e dei fondi di investimento di Pictet. I nostri team assicurano che tutte le attività seguano le normative e gestiscano i rischi. Sviluppando e mantenendo un'infrastruttura moderna e robusta, garantiamo servizi affidabili e di alta qualità per la gestione della ricchezza Pictet, la gestione degli asset e i clienti immobiliari. Il tuo ruolo
• Come agente di servizio client (interno ed esterno), giocare un ruolo attivo nella risoluzione dei problemi e rispondere prontamente ai clienti, in coordinamento con altri dipartimenti.
• Rispondendo a diverse richieste da parte di investitori e clienti per garantire che venga fornito un servizio di qualità, che soddisfi i requisiti dei clienti di fascia alta.
• Fornire supporto ai richiedenti interni (clienti, gestori di fondi e altri dipartimenti).
• Essere attivamente coinvolti in progetti di miglioramento pianificato/inganno nel team del Servizio Clienti.
• Come intermediario privilegiato per investitori e clienti, fornendo comunicazione per garantire che gli ordini del cliente siano registrati senza errori e nel rispetto delle clausole dei vari prospetti e delle normative vigenti.
• Partecipa a due riunioni diligence, recensioni dei servizi, visite dei clienti come richiesto. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea magistrale in Economia o Finanza
• Fluente in francese e inglese
• Min 5 anni di esperienza in una funzione simile e/o di lavoro come agente di trasferimento
• Comprensione approfondita dell'amministrazione dei fondi di investimento.
• Una volontà di impegnarsi a lungo termine, lavorando in un reparto che è costantemente in fase di cambiamento.
• Resistente allo stress, dinamico, rigoroso e mostrando l'iniziativa quando risolve i problemi.
• Una mente esigente con la capacità di afferrare rapidamente le cose nuove.
• Un forte senso del servizio clienti e la volontà di trovare soluzioni adeguate. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• As a client servicing agent (internal and external), playing an active role in problem solving and responding to clients promptly, in coordination with other departments.

• Responding to different requests from investors and clients to guarantee that a quality service is provided, which meets the requirements of high-end clients.

• Providing support to internal requesters (clients, fund managers and other departments).

• Being actively involved in planned/ongoing improvement projects in the Client Service team.

• As a privileged intermediary for investors and clients, providing communication to ensure that client orders are recorded without error and in compliance with the clauses of the various prospectuses and with the regulations in force.

• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits as required.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Economics or Finance

• Fluent in french and english

• Min 5 years experience in a similar function and/or working as a Transfer Agent

• In-depth understanding of investment fund administration.

• A willingness to commit to the long term, working in a department that is constantly undergoing change.

• Resistant to stress, dynamic, rigorous and showing initiative when solving problems.

• An enquiring mind with the ability to grasp new things quickly.

• A keen sense of client service and a willingness to find appropriate solutions.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra La divisione Operazioni è responsabile dell’elaborazione sicura ed efficiente delle operazioni bancarie e delle attività dei fondi di investimento di Pictet. Per sostenere questa missione, il team Risk & Compliance – Operations identifica, valuta e mitiga i rischi operativi garantendo nel contempo la conformità alle politiche interne e alle normative applicabili. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un Senior Risk & Compliance Manager con un forte background nel rischio operativo bancario e la conformità, e la capacità di condurre importanti iniziative di rischio attraverso operazioni bancarie. L'esperienza nella salvaguardia dei criptoasset, così come la competenza nella gestione dei dati, nell'analisi dei dati o nella scienza dei dati per l'ottimizzazione e la segnalazione dei processi, sarebbe un bene prezioso. Il tuo ruolo
• sostenere l'identificazione e l'analisi delle tendenze dei rischi operativi emergenti.
• per rivedere periodicamente l'appetito e la tolleranza del rischio operativo, sviluppare indicatori di rischio chiave (KRIs) e monitorare la loro efficacia.
• coordinare e contribuire al processo RCSA (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) per le operazioni bancarie.
• fornire supporto consultivo alla prima linea di difesa in materia di rischi operativi e gestire specifiche richieste di conformità operativa.
• guidare progetti di rischio chiave e piani di azione all'interno delle operazioni bancarie, assicurando la consegna tempestiva e l'escalation, se necessario.
• utilizzare le capacità di gestione dei dati e di analisi dei dati per migliorare il monitoraggio dei rischi, il reporting e i processi decisionali.
• per ricevere, registrare e monitorare gli incidenti operativi, e supervisionare l'analisi causa radice e il follow-up amministrativo.
• monitorare i piani di mitigazione dei rischi e degli incidenti e monitorare l'attuazione delle raccomandazioni di audit.
• preparare rapporti chiari e concisi sui rischi e presentazioni per gli organi di governance e le funzioni centrali.
• promuovere una forte cultura del rischio attraverso la formazione, i workshop e le attività di sensibilizzazione.
• per mantenere il contatto regolare con i responsabili del rischio e gli agenti di conformità attraverso linee aziendali, divisioni e entità di Gruppo all'estero. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea in finanza, affari, diritto o economia, o qualifica professionale considerata equivalente.
• Almeno cinque o otto anni di esperienza rilevante nel rischio operativo, nel rispetto o nell’audit di un istituto bancario o finanziario di medie dimensioni o di grandi dimensioni.
• Forte gestione degli stakeholder e influenzando le competenze, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con la gestione senior.
• Prove capacità di condurre i progetti con successo.
• Competenze analitiche eccellenti e attenzione ai dettagli; competenza in MS Office/Excel; conoscenza di Tableau sarebbe un bene.
• La solida conoscenza della gestione dei dati, dell'analisi dei dati o della scienza dei dati, e la loro applicazione nell'ottimizzazione dei processi, nella segnalazione dei rischi o nell'automazione, sarebbe altamente auspicabile.
• Fluency in francese e inglese (spoken e scritto), con almeno C1 livello o equivalente in ogni lingua.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera. Rif. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Operations division is responsible for the secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment fund activities. To support this mission, the Risk & Compliance – Operations team identifies, assesses and mitigates operational risks while ensuring compliance with internal policies and applicable regulations.

To bolster our team, we are seeking a Senior Risk & Compliance Manager with a strong background in banking operational risk and compliance, and the ability to lead major risk initiatives across Banking Operations. Experience in safeguarding cryptoassets, as well as expertise in data management, data analysis or data science for process optimisation and reporting, would be a valuable asset.

Your role

• to support the identification and analysis of emerging operational risk trends.

• to periodically review operational risk appetite and tolerance, develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and monitor their effectiveness.

• to coordinate and contribute to the RCSA (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) process for Banking Operations.

• to provide advisory support to the first line of defence on operational risk matters and handle specific operational compliance requests.

• to drive key risk projects and action plans within Banking Operations, ensuring timely delivery and escalation where needed.

• to use data management and data analysis skills to enhance risk monitoring, reporting and decision-making processes.

• to receive, log and monitor operational incidents, and oversee root-cause analysis and administrative follow-up.

• to monitor risk and incident mitigation plans and track the implementation of audit recommendations.

• to prepare clear, concise risk reports and presentations for governance bodies and central functions.

• to promote a strong risk culture through training, workshops and awareness activities.

• to maintain regular contact with risk managers and compliance officers across business lines, divisions and Group entities abroad.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Business, Law or Economics, or professional qualification deemed equivalent.

• At least five to eight years’ relevant experience in operational risk, compliance or audit at a mid-sized or large bank or financial institution.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior management.

• Proven ability to lead projects successfully.

• Excellent analytical skills and keen attention to detail; proficiency in MS Office/Excel; knowledge of Tableau would be an asset.

• Sound knowledge of data management, data analysis or data science, and their application in process optimisation, risk reporting or automation, would be highly desirable.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written), with at least C1 level or equivalent in each language.

• Must be resident in Switzerland.

Ref. SRCM/CRO/AS

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Dein Team Der Geschäftsbereich Operations ist für die sichere und effiziente Abwicklung der Bankgeschäfte und Investmentfondsaktivitäten von Pictet verantwortlich. Um diese Mission zu unterstützen, identifiziert, bewertet und mindert das Team Risk & Compliance – Operations operationelle Risiken und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und geltender Vorschriften sicher. Um unser Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen Senior Risk & Compliance Manager mit einem starken Hintergrund in den Bereichen operatives Risiko und Compliance im Bankensektor und der Fähigkeit, wichtige Risikoinitiativen im Bankgeschäft zu leiten. Erfahrung in der Absicherung von Krypto-Assets sowie Fachwissen in den Bereichen Datenmanagement, Datenanalyse oder Data Science zur Prozessoptimierung und -berichterstattung wären ein wertvolles Gut. Deine Rolle
• Unterstützung bei der Ermittlung und Analyse von sich abzeichnenden operationellen Risikotrends.
• regelmäßige Überprüfung der operationellen Risikobereitschaft und -toleranz, Entwicklung von Schlüsselrisikoindikatoren (KRI) und Überwachung ihrer Wirksamkeit.
• Koordinierung und Beitrag zum RCSA-Prozess (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) für Bankgeschäfte.
• Beratung bei der ersten Verteidigungslinie in Fragen des operationellen Risikos und Bearbeitung spezifischer Anträge auf Einhaltung des Betriebs.
• Förderung wichtiger Risikoprojekte und Aktionspläne im Bankgeschäft, um bei Bedarf eine rechtzeitige Umsetzung und Eskalation zu gewährleisten.
• Nutzung von Datenmanagement- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten zur Verbesserung der Risikoüberwachung, der Berichterstattung und der Entscheidungsprozesse.
• Entgegennahme, Protokollierung und Überwachung operativer Vorfälle sowie Überwachung der Ursachenanalyse und der administrativen Folgemaßnahmen.
• Überwachung der Risiko- und Störungsminderungspläne und Verfolgung der Umsetzung der Auditempfehlungen.
• Erstellung klarer, prägnanter Risikoberichte und -präsentationen für Leitungsorgane und zentrale Funktionen.
• Förderung einer starken Risikokultur durch Schulungen, Workshops und Sensibilisierungsmaßnahmen.
• regelmäßige Kontakte zu Risikomanagern und Compliance-Beauftragten über Geschäftsbereiche, Divisionen und Konzerngesellschaften im Ausland hinweg zu pflegen. Dein Profil
• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Recht oder Wirtschaft oder berufliche Qualifikation als gleichwertig angesehen.
• Mindestens fünf bis acht Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in den Bereichen operationelles Risiko, Compliance oder Audit bei einer mittelgroßen oder großen Bank oder einem Finanzinstitut.
• Starkes Stakeholder-Management und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit der Geschäftsleitung zu interagieren.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Projekte erfolgreich zu leiten.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten und scharfe Liebe zum Detail; Kenntnisse in MS Office / Excel; Kenntnisse von Tableau wären ein Gewinn.
• Ein fundiertes Wissen über Datenmanagement, Datenanalyse oder Data Science und deren Anwendung in der Prozessoptimierung, Risikoberichterstattung oder Automatisierung wäre sehr wünschenswert.
• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben), mit mindestens C1 Niveau oder gleichwertig in jeder Sprache.
• Muss in der Schweiz wohnen. Ref. Pour appuyer cette mission, l'équipe des risques et de la conformité – Opérations identifie, évalue et atténue les risques opérationnels tout en assurant le respect des politiques internes et des règlements applicables. Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous cherchons un gestionnaire principal des risques et de la conformité ayant une solide expérience en matière de risques opérationnels et de conformité bancaires, et la capacité de diriger d'importantes initiatives en matière de risques dans l'ensemble des opérations bancaires. L'expérience en matière de protection des cryptoactifs, ainsi que l'expertise en gestion des données, en analyse des données ou en science des données pour l'optimisation des processus et l'établissement de rapports seraient un atout précieux. Votre rôle
• appuyer l'identification et l'analyse des nouvelles tendances des risques opérationnels.
• examiner périodiquement l'appétit et la tolérance aux risques opérationnels, élaborer des indicateurs de risque clés et surveiller leur efficacité.
• coordonner et contribuer au processus d'autoévaluation des risques et du contrôle des opérations bancaires.
• fournir un soutien consultatif à la première ligne de défense en matière de risques opérationnels et traiter des demandes de conformité opérationnelle spécifiques.
• d'encourager les projets à risque et les plans d'action clés au sein des opérations bancaires, en veillant à ce qu'ils soient exécutés en temps opportun et qu'ils augmentent au besoin.
• utiliser les compétences en gestion des données et en analyse des données pour améliorer la surveillance des risques, les rapports et les processus décisionnels.
• de recevoir, d'enregistrer et de surveiller les incidents opérationnels et de superviser l'analyse des causes profondes et le suivi administratif.
• surveiller les plans d'atténuation des risques et des incidents et suivre la mise en oeuvre des recommandations de vérification.
• préparer des rapports et des exposés clairs et concis sur les risques pour les organes de gouvernance et les fonctions centrales.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Entro PWM Operazioni & IT, combiniamo competenze di business e tecnologia per costruire la piattaforma di investimento di domani - scalabile, data-driven e focalizzato sul valore del cliente. Ti unirai a un team ad alto impatto, modellando processi di investimento end-to-end in tutto il Front Office: Piattaforma di investimento, Trading, Compliance e Operazioni. Ti riferirai al Capo di PWM Digital Solutions – Investimenti e lavori in stretto contatto con Product Manager e Business Analysts. Stiamo cercando un BPM che vuole andare oltre la gestione dei processi e svolgere un ruolo attivo nella definizione di come le capacità di investimento sono progettati, scalati e consegnati attraverso una stretta collaborazione tra le squadre. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive range of support for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions, as well as family office services.

PWM Digital Solutions – is at the heart of the Tech Wealth Management transformation.

Within PWM Operations & IT, we combine business and technology expertise to build the Tech tools for the investment platform of tomorrow — scalable, data-driven and focused on client value.

You will join a high-impact team , shaping how Tech improves the end-to-end investment platform processes across the Front Office: Investment Platform, Trading, Compliance and Operations.

You will report to the Head of PWM Digital Solutions – Investment and work in closely with Product Managers and Business Analysts.

Your role

This role offers a unique opportunity to support the tech transformation of the investment processes , with a strong focus on risk, performance, valuation and advanced calculation capabilities .

You will work at the heart of the investment value chain, ensuring that processes and data flows enable robust analytics, efficient execution and better investment decisions .

Your key functional focus:

• Risk and performance, valuation, scenario analysis and simulation

• Calculation engines (cash management, optimisation, collateral consumption, etc.)

Your impact:

• Be accountable to lead the resolution of complex tech & business process challenges, including Tech process documentation across the investment lifecycle and beyond.

• Act as a functional expert between Tech & Investment Platform for performance & risk, valuation, and calculation topics.

• Strengthen data and calculation frameworks to ensure accuracy and scalability.

• Connect teams across silos (Front, Investment Platform, Trading, Compliance, IT & Operations) – to build strong alignment & collaboration.

• Turn complexity into clarity , improving efficiency and user experience.

• Transform incidents into lasting improvements by identifying gaps and collaborating with Product Managers, Business Analysts & support teams.

• Enabling decision-making through clear process governance and stakeholder engagement.

• Build durable knowledge and transparency across tech teams, business experts & processes.

Your profile

• Approximately 10 years’ in-depth expertise in:

• Technology

• risk and performance

• valuation, scenario analysis and simulations

• calculation engines, including cash-management and optimisation.

• Tech-savvy, with ability to work across business and technology (including APIs and data platform).

• Proven experience in investment processes in a cross-functional role.

• Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to simplify complex topics.

• Structured, autonomous and delivery-focused.

• Knowledge of collateral management would be an advantage.

• Fluent in French and English.

• Resident in Switzerland.

Are you:

• Passionate about bringing rigour and scalability to investment processes with the help of technology

• Energised by complex environments and high-impact roles

• Able to influence across teams and break silos

• Focused on delivering concrete, measurable outcomes

• Willing to shape the future Tech operating model , not just maintain it

We are looking for a BPM who wants to go beyond process management — and actively shape how Tech investment capabilities are designed, scaled, and delivered with a collaborative approach.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra In qualità di Responsabile dell'Amministrazione del Fondo, gestisci la supervisione generale delle attività di gestione dei fondi di investimento svizzeri, garantendo la qualità, la conformità e l'efficienza dei processi. Sei il punto di ingresso per richieste operative e di governance relative ai fondi, coordinare le attività delegate e sostenere clienti interni ed esterni nella riflessione e nell'implementazione di nuovi fondi. Si gioca un ruolo chiave nella supervisione delle operazioni, compresa la valutazione dei beni illiquidi (Equità privata), e nell'evoluzione degli strumenti di controllo e dei metodi. Il tuo ruolo
• Superare il processo di calcolo del valore dell'inventario netto (NV), effettuare controlli adeguati e supervisione delle operazioni delegati.
• Assicurare la valutazione degli investimenti, compresi i beni alternativi, e supervisionare le attività preparatorie delegati
• Monitorare e convalidare le tasse, le tasse e i dividendi applicati ai fondi in conformità con i prospetti e i contratti.
• Preparare e rivedere le chiusure annuali e semestrali dei fondi, condurre una revisione critica dei conti, proporre modifiche necessarie.
• Organizzare e monitorare gli audit dei fondi (interni ed esterni), coordinare gli scambi con i revisori e rispondere alle loro richieste.
• Coordinare e convalidare l'emissione di rapporti normativi e finanziari, garantire la loro diffusione agli stakeholder (FINMA, clienti, CA).
• Gestire tutte le transazioni correnti a livello di fondi sotto amministrazione (contributo o uscita, flusso agente di trasferimento, ecc.)
• Monitorare le statistiche SNB e garantire la conformità dei dati trasmessi.
• Monitorare la tassazione dei fondi, monitorare i rendimenti e le richieste, partecipare al coordinamento con le autorità fiscali.
• Elaborare e monitorare i conti finanziari della società.
• Fornire supporto operativo ai vari servizi interni ed esterni all'azienda e monitorare le richieste dei clienti.
• Siate il punto di ingresso e di follow-up per tutte le richieste operative e di governance rivolte alla gestione dei fondi, sia da parte di clienti interni (Pictet) che di clienti esterni (fondi di terze parti)
• Sostenere i clienti nella riflessione e nella strutturazione di nuovi fondi, fornendo una visione di consulenza e competenze tecniche.
• Gli strumenti di pilota e di supporto e i progetti di automazione di controllo, propongono sviluppi per migliorare l'efficienza e la sicurezza dei processi.
• Contribuire al mantenimento della corporate governance e partecipare alla preparazione del reporting per i comitati di gestione e il Consiglio di Amministrazione. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, economia o formazione ritenuto equivalente.
• Esperienza confermata di almeno 8 anni nell'audit, nell'amministrazione dei fondi o in una posizione simile nel settore bancario/finanziario
• Esperienza nella gestione del team e nella conduzione di progetti di automazione o sviluppo di strumenti/processi.
• Forte conoscenza operativa e tecnica sui fondi (contabilità, tassazione, processo di calcolo NAV, prezzi, reporting, controllo interno).
• Buona comprensione delle normative svizzere e internazionali applicabili ai fondi (LPCC, LEFin, LSFin, ecc.).
• Mastery of French (lingua di lavoro), ottima conoscenza dell'inglese (scritto e orale), tedesco è un bene.
• Mastery di MS Office strumenti e sistemi di gestione fondi (Avaloq, Multifunds, ecc. un plus).
• Rigor, precisione, senso di organizzazione e dettaglio.
• Proattività, autonomia, capacità di risolvere i problemi e gestire più compiti contemporaneamente.
• Spirito di squadra, capacità di collaborare con diversi dipartimenti e di comunicare con vari interlocutori.
• Curiosità intellettuale, capacità di apprendimento, iniziativa e orientamento del cliente.
• Residenza in Svizzera o disponibilità a stabilirsi lì. Your team As Head of Fund Administration, you manage the overall supervision of Swiss investment fund administration activities, ensuring the quality, compliance and efficiency of the processes. You are the point of entry for fund-related operational and governance requests, coordinate delegated activities, and support internal and external clients in the reflection and implementation of new funds. You play a key role in the supervision of operations, including the valuation of illiquid assets (Private Equity), and in the evolution of control tools and methods. Your role
• Supervise the process of calculating net inventory value (NV), carry out proper controls and supervision of delegated operations.
• Ensure valuation of investments, including alternative assets, and supervise delegated preparatory activities
• Monitor and validate fees, fees and dividends applied to funds in accordance with prospectuses and contracts.
• Prepare and review annual and semi-annual fund closures, conduct a critical review of accounts, propose necessary adjustments.
• Organize and monitor audits of funds (internal and external), coordinate exchanges with auditors, and respond to their requests.
• Coordinate and validate the issuance of regulatory and financial reports, ensure their dissemination to stakeholders (FINMA, clients, CA).
• Manage all current transactions at the level of funds under administration (in-kind contribution or exit, transfer agent flow, etc.)
• Monitor SNB statistics and ensure compliance of data transmitted.
• Monitor the taxation of funds, monitor returns and claims, participate in coordination with tax authorities.
• Process and monitor the financial accounts of the company.
• Provide operational support to the various internal and external services to the company and monitor client requests.
• Be the point of entry and follow-up for all operational and governance requests addressed to fund management, both by internal clients (Pictet) and external clients (third party funds)
• To support clients in the reflection and structuring of new funds, providing a consulting vision and technical expertise.
• Pilot and support tools and controls automation projects, propose developments to enhance process efficiency and security.
• Contribute to the maintenance of corporate governance and participate in the preparation of reporting for management committees and the Board of Directors. Your profile
• University degree in finance, accounting, economics or training deemed equivalent.
• Confirmed experience of at least 8 years in the audit, fund administration or similar position in the banking/financial sector
• Experience in team management and in conducting automation or tool/process development projects.
• Strong operational and technical knowledge on funds (accounting, taxation, NAV calculation process, pricing, reporting, internal control).
• Good understanding of Swiss and international regulations applicable to funds (LPCC, LEFin, LSFin, etc.).
• Mastery of French (working language), excellent knowledge of English (written and oral), German is an asset.
• Mastery of MS Office tools and fund management systems (Avaloq, Multifunds, etc. a plus).
• Rigor, precision, sense of organization and detail.
• Proactivity, autonomy, ability to solve problems and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Team spirit, ability to collaborate with different departments and to communicate with various interlocutors.
• Intellectual curiosity, learning capacity, initiative and customer orientation.
• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to settle there. Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Research team. You will conduct in-depth fundamental research on companies across developed markets, with a particular focus on consumer sectors, develop comprehensive financial models, and deliver high-conviction investment recommendations to internal stakeholders, especially portfolio managers and advisors.

Your role

• Fundamental research: Perform deep-dive research into companies, industries, and macroeconomic trends to identify mispriced securities.
• Financial modeling: Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Investment recommendations: Author investment memos and deliver actionable recommendations to Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due diligence: Conduct management interviews, attend industry conferences, and interact with sell-side analysts to gather proprietary insights.
• AI-augmented research: Design and apply AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate idea generation, enhance pattern detection, and increase the agility and scalability of fundamental research.

Your profile

• University degree: Master’s degree or a postgraduate qualification such as a CFA.
• At least 6 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, ideally with multi-sector coverage; prior exposure to an Anglo-Saxon firm is a strong plus.
• Excellent command of written and spoken English (native or equivalent), and fluent or better command of written and spoken French.
• Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative and qualitative skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.
• Outstanding written communication skills through investment memos and research notes, and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly.
• Complete proficiency in Bloomberg and Microsoft tools.
• Confident and effective user of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications, to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency.
• Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Strong focus on delivering high-quality, actionable outputs and meeting results-based expectations in a demanding investment environment.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Ref: BSA/AJ/MJ

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in Hong Kong for 40 years where it employs around 200 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

Your role

Mission

To lead the Business Risk and Compliance Management Team (“BRCM”), executing strategic initiatives while bridging operational execution with independent risk and compliance oversight.
To bridge the gap between business and independent risk management through advisory and day-to-day controls.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership

• Lead and supervise the operations of the BRCM team, ensuring an effective first line of defense control environment for Wealth Management.

• Support Management in fostering a strong risk awareness culture.

• Represent BRCM in governance committees for local and global initiatives and projects.

• Provide regular reports to Senior Management and Group PWM Risk and Compliance Management on BRCM activities and risk-related matters.

Oversight and Operational Excellence

• Monitor both anti-money laundering and non-anti-money laundering risks, advising Senior Management on enhancements to risk controls.

• Offer guidance to the front office on matters related to anti-money laundering and other compliance issues.

• Identify all types of risks, including compliance risks; design frameworks and implement mitigation measures for Wealth Management.

• Oversee and continuously improve the efficiency of the BRCM team across all business risk and compliance processes.

• Supervise the resolution of relevant audits and inspections.

• Provide support and feedback on New Product Services (NPS), ensuring that all business risk and compliance considerations are appropriately addressed.

• Perform any other duties as assigned.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) è un leader di asset manager di investimento alternativo che fa parte del Gruppo Pictet, con un focus su private equity, immobili, private credit and hedge fund. Pictet Group ha attualmente più di 50 miliardi di euro di AUM in alternative e più di 25 miliardi di euro di private equity AUM. Pictet ha lanciato il suo primo fondo di private equity diretto nel 2023, con un focus sugli investimenti di buyout europei di mercato medio, aumentando oltre €430m.
Poiché il fondo è ora in distribuzione attiva, stiamo cercando di espandere la nostra capacità di origine e assumere un Professionista di Originazione dedicato al mercato medio inferiore DACH.
Sarete parte di un team di 13 professionisti dedicati al fondo di private equity diretto. Il team investe principalmente in tutto il Regno Unito e DACH in aziende fondatrici nei servizi e nell'istruzione B2B.
Il vostro ruolo sarà basato su Zurigo con frequenti viaggi attraverso DACH e Londra, dove il fondo è basato.

Il tuo ruolo

In qualità di membro chiave del team di private equity diretto, sarai responsabile della generazione di una pipeline coerente e di alta qualità di opportunità di acquisizione proprietarie nel mercato inferiore DACH (EBITDA da 2 a 10 milioni di euro, aziende gestite dal proprietario). Il ruolo combina l'accesso diretto del fondatore e la copertura del consulente finanziario aziendale che supporta le priorità di investimento tematiche del team, e lo sviluppo di un moderno stack di tecnologia di origine. Le tue responsabilità includono:

• Origine diretta:

• Condurre la mappatura strutturata delle aziende all'interno di sottosettori allineati alle priorità tematiche del fondo;

• Eseguire la formazione multicanale strutturata per le imprese fondatrici;

• Viaggiare attraverso DACH per soddisfare gli imprenditori, qualificare le opportunità contro i criteri di investimento e nutrire le prospettive a lungo termine attraverso la gestione strutturata dei rapporti CRM;

• Valutare e distribuire nuovi strumenti di origine per scalare il bordo di sourcing dell'azienda.

• Consigliere e copertura intermedia:

• Costruire e mantenere un dialogo attivo con i consulenti regionali, le boutique di finanza aziendale e i contabili che consigliano le aziende gestite dal proprietario all'uscita;

• Viaggiare regolarmente attraverso DACH per incontrare i consulenti e posizionare il fondo in modo coerente per assicurarsi che sia il massimo della mente per i prossimi mandati di vendita.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea universitaria da un'istituzione forte; soggetto di laurea è secondario guidare, giudizio e istinto di origine.

• Tedesco madrelingua / lingua e forte fluenza inglese.

• 7-10 anni di esperienza lavorativa totale tra cui 2-5 anni in un ruolo incentrato sul contatto diretto e regolare con i proprietari di affari e i decisori senior nel Regno Unito - origine, sviluppo aziendale o freddo-outreach esperienza è essenziale.

• L'esperienza di origine in una società di private equity o in media consulenza di finanza aziendale è fortemente preferita; sfondi alternativi saranno considerati dove sono presenti forti attributi personali e l'esperienza di origine.

• Visibile energia di origine: un auto-starter risorse e resiliente con alti livelli di attività, confortevole con approcci freddi, il telefono e regolare viaggio DACH.

• Genuine persone: costruisce il rapporto naturalmente con i fondatori di aziende gestite dal proprietario, dimostrando maturità e giudizio commerciale, e guadagna fiducia rapidamente con gli intermediari.

• Fluente nella tecnologia di origine moderna (CRM, strumenti AI e piattaforme di outreach), attivamente curioso di implementare nuovi strumenti per scalare la sourcing proprietaria.

Al di là delle competenze professionali, il candidato ideale dovrebbe dimostrare la fame e il trambusto intelligente - alto rendimento abbinato a priorità acuta - accanto al giudizio commerciale, l'integrità nel trattare il fondatore sensibile e le conversazioni dei consulenti, e un approccio pragmatico per risolvere i problemi.

Come candidato scelto, avrete l'opportunità unica di unire una delle principali istituzioni finanziarie private del mondo. Sarete incorporati in un ambizioso team di investimenti diretti, lavorando in un ambiente dinamico "start-up" e approfittando del supporto di esperti professionisti senior all'interno del team PAA e del più ampio Gruppo Pictet.

Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate, private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM. Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on mid-market European buyout investments, raising over €430m.
As the fund is now in active deployment, we are looking to expand our origination capability and hire an Origination Professional dedicated to the DACH lower mid-market.
You will be part of a team of 13 professionals dedicated to the direct private equity fund. The team invests primarily across the UK and DACH in founder-led businesses in B2B services and education.
Your role will be based out of Zurich with frequent travel across DACH and London, where the fund is based.

Your role

As a key member of the direct private equity team, you will be responsible for generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline of proprietary acquisition opportunities in the DACH lower mid-market (€2–10m EBITDA, owner-managed businesses). The role combines direct founder outreach as well as corporate finance adviser coverage supporting the team’s thematic investment priorities, and the development of a modern origination tech stack. Your responsibilities will include:

• Direct Origination:

• Conduct structured mapping of companies within sub-sectors aligned to the fund's thematic priorities;

• Run structured multi-channel outreach to founder-led businesses;

• Travel across DACH to meet entrepreneurs, qualify opportunities against investment criteria, and nurture longer-term prospects through structured CRM-driven relationship management;

• Evaluate and deploy new origination tools to scale the firm's sourcing edge.

• Adviser & Intermediary Coverage:

• Build and maintain active dialogue with regional advisers, corporate finance boutiques and accountants who advise owner-managed businesses on exit;

• Travel regularly across DACH to meet advisers and position the fund consistently to ensure it is top of mind for upcoming sale mandates.

Your profile

• University degree from a strong institution; degree subject is secondary to drive, judgement and origination instinct.

• German native / mother tongue and strong English fluency.

• 7-10 years total work experience including 2-5 years in a role centred on direct, regular contact with business owners and senior decision-makers in the UK - origination, business development or cold-outreach experience is essential.

• Origination experience at a private equity firm or in mid-market corporate finance advisory is strongly preferred; alternative backgrounds will be considered where strong personal attributes and origination experience are present.

• Visible origination energy: a resourceful and resilient self-starter with high activity levels, comfortable with cold approaches, the phone, and regular DACH travel.

• Genuine people person: builds rapport naturally with founders of owner-managed businesses, demonstrating maturity and commercial judgement, and earns trust quickly with intermediaries.

• Fluent in modern origination technology (CRM, AI tools and outreach platforms), actively curious about deploying new tools to scale proprietary sourcing.

Beyond professional skills, the ideal candidate should demonstrate hunger and smart hustle - high output paired with sharp prioritisation - alongside commercial judgement, integrity in handling sensitive founder and adviser conversations, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

As the chosen candidate, you'll have the unique opportunity to join one of the world's leading private financial institutions. You'll be embedded in an ambitious direct investments team, working in a dynamic "start-up" environment while benefiting from the support of experienced senior professionals within the PAA team and the broader Pictet Group.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) ist ein führender alternativer Investment-Asset-Manager, der Teil der Pictet-Gruppe ist und sich auf Private Equity, Immobilien, private Kredite und Hedgefonds konzentriert. Die Pictet Group verfügt derzeit über mehr als 50 Mrd. € AUM an Alternativen und über mehr als 25 Mrd. € Private Equity AUM. Pictet startete seinen ersten direkten Private-Equity-Fonds im Jahr 2023 mit einem Fokus auf mittelständische europäische Buyout-Investitionen und erzielte über 430 Millionen Euro.
Da sich der Fonds nun im aktiven Einsatz befindet, wollen wir unsere Origination-Kapazität erweitern und einen Origination Professional einstellen, der sich dem unteren Mittelstand von DACH widmet.
Sie werden Teil eines Teams von 13 Fachleuten sein, die sich dem direkten Private-Equity-Fonds widmen. Das Team investiert hauptsächlich in Großbritannien und DACH in gründergeführte Unternehmen in B2B-Dienstleistungen und Bildung.
Ihre Rolle wird aus Zürich mit häufigen Reisen über DACH und London, wo der Fonds basiert.

Deine Rolle

Als wichtiges Mitglied des Direkt-Private-Equity-Teams sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, eine konsistente, qualitativ hochwertige Pipeline von eigenen Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten im unteren DACH-Mittelstand zu generieren (2-10 Mio. € EBITDA, inhabergeführte Unternehmen). Die Rolle kombiniert direkte Gründer-Outreach sowie Corporate Finance Advisor-Abdeckung, die die thematischen Investitionsprioritäten des Teams unterstützt, und die Entwicklung eines modernen Origination-Tech-Stacks. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

• Direktursprung:

• Durchführung einer strukturierten Zuordnung von Unternehmen innerhalb von Teilsektoren, die auf die thematischen Prioritäten des Fonds ausgerichtet sind;

• Führen Sie strukturierte Multi-Channel-Outreachs für von Gründern geführte Unternehmen durch;

• Reisen Sie durch DACH, um Unternehmer zu treffen, Chancen anhand von Anlagekriterien zu qualifizieren und langfristige Perspektiven durch strukturiertes CRM-gesteuertes Beziehungsmanagement zu fördern;

• Bewerten und implementieren Sie neue Origination-Tools, um den Sourcing-Vorsprung des Unternehmens zu skalieren.

• Berater & Vermittler Coverage:

• Aufbau und Pflege eines aktiven Dialogs mit regionalen Beratern, Corporate Finance Boutiquen und Wirtschaftsprüfern, die inhabergeführte Unternehmen beim Ausstieg beraten;

• Reisen Sie regelmäßig durch DACH, um Berater zu treffen und den Fonds konsequent zu positionieren, um sicherzustellen, dass er bei bevorstehenden Verkaufsmandaten im Vordergrund steht.

Dein Profil

• Universitätsabschluss von einer starken Institution; Grad Thema ist sekundär zu Antrieb, Urteil und Ursprung Instinkt.

• Deutsche Muttersprache und starkes Englisch fließend.

• 7-10 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon 2-5 Jahre in einer Rolle, die sich auf den direkten, regelmäßigen Kontakt mit Geschäftsinhabern und leitenden Entscheidungsträgern in Großbritannien konzentriert - Entstehung, Geschäftsentwicklung oder Cold-Outreach-Erfahrung sind unerlässlich.

• Originationserfahrung bei einer Private-Equity-Firma oder in der mittelständischen Unternehmensfinanzierungsberatung wird stark bevorzugt; alternative Hintergründe werden in Betracht gezogen, wenn starke persönliche Eigenschaften und Originationserfahrung vorhanden sind.

• Sichtbare Entstehungsenergie: ein einfallsreicher und belastbarer Selbststarter mit hoher Aktivität, komfortabel mit kalten Ansätzen, dem Telefon und regelmäßigen DACH-Reisen.

• Echte Menschen Person: baut eine natürliche Beziehung zu Gründern von inhabergeführten Unternehmen auf, zeigt Reife und kaufmännisches Urteilsvermögen und verdient schnell Vertrauen bei Vermittlern.

• Fließend in moderner Origination-Technologie (CRM, KI-Tools und Outreach-Plattformen), aktiv neugierig auf den Einsatz neuer Tools zur Skalierung proprietärer Sourcing.

Über die beruflichen Fähigkeiten hinaus sollte der ideale Kandidat Hunger und kluge Hektik zeigen - hohe Leistung gepaart mit scharfer Priorisierung - neben kommerziellem Urteilsvermögen, Integrität im Umgang mit sensiblen Gründer- und Beratergesprächen und einem pragmatischen Ansatz zur Problemlösung.

Als gewählter Kandidat haben Sie die einmalige Gelegenheit, einer der weltweit führenden privaten Finanzinstitute beizutreten. Sie sind in ein ehrgeiziges Direktinvestitionsteam eingebettet, das in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld arbeitet und gleichzeitig von der Unterstützung erfahrener Führungskräfte innerhalb des PAA-Teams und der Pictet-Gruppe profitiert.

Comme le fonds est maintenant en déploiement actif, nous cherchons à développer notre capacité d'origine et à embaucher un professionnel d'origine dédié à la DACH inférieure du milieu du marché.
Vous ferez partie d'une équipe de 13 professionnels dédiée au fonds de capital-investissement direct. L'équipe investit principalement à travers le Royaume-Uni et DACH dans des entreprises dirigées par un fondateur dans les services B2B et l'éducation.
Votre rôle sera basé à Zurich avec des voyages fréquents à travers DACH et Londres, où le fonds est basé.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire d'une institution forte; sujet de diplôme est secondaire à la conduite, le jugement et l'instinct d'origine.

Pictet è presente a Singapore da oltre 30 anni, sostenuto da un team superiore a 200 dipendenti. Stiamo cercando un diligente e intuitivo Buy-Side Analyst per aderire al nostro Asia Equity Research team. Sarete responsabili di condurre una ricerca fondamentale approfondita sulle aziende di tutti i settori dei mercati asiatici, con un focus sulle aziende industriali, energetiche e dei consumatori; sviluppare tesi di investimento complete; e fornire raccomandazioni di investimento ad alta concorrenza ai nostri stakeholder interni, in particolare ai responsabili del portafoglio e ai consulenti. Alcune competenze per il settore tecnologico e le sue principali aziende sarebbero vantaggiose. Il tuo ruolo
• Ricerca fondamentale: Eseguire ricerche approfondite su aziende, industrie e tendenze macroeconomiche per identificare i valori mobiliari errati; primo focus sulle aziende industriali e dei consumatori.
• Modellazione finanziaria: costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari complessi e dinamici per prevedere guadagni e rendimenti futuri.
• Raccomandazioni di investimento: Autori di investimento memos e fornire raccomandazioni attuabili a Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due diligence: Conduct management interviste, partecipare conferenze del settore, e interagire con gli analisti del settore per raccogliere informazioni proprietarie.

Your team The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. Pictet has been present in Singapore for over 30 years, supported by a team exceeding 200 employees. We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Asia Equity Research team. You will be responsible for conducting in-depth fundamental research on companies across sectors in Asian markets, with a focus on industrial, energy, and consumer companies; developing comprehensive investment theses; and providing high-conviction investment recommendations to our internal stakeholders, in particular portfolio managers and advisors. Some expertise to the technology sector and its major companies would be beneficial. Your role
• Fundamental research: Perform deep-dive research into companies, industries, and macroeconomic trends to identify mispriced securities; initial focus on Industrial and Consumer companies.
• Financial modelling: Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Investment recommendations: Author investment memos and deliver actionable recommendations to Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due diligence: Conduct management interviews, attend industry conferences, and interact with sell-side analysts to gather proprietary insights.
• AI-augmented research: Design and apply AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate idea generation, enhance pattern detection, and increase the agility and scalability of fundamental research. Your profile
• Experience: At least 6 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, ideally with multi-sector coverage; prior exposure to a leading financial institution is a strong plus.
• Language skills: Excellent command of written and spoken English (native or equivalent) and fluent or better command of written and spoken Mandarin as the role requires frequent research and communication involving Chinese companies and Mandarin-language sources
• Research & Analytical Skills: Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative (but non-quant) skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.
• Communication & Presentation Skills: Outstanding written communication skills (investment memos, research notes) and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly.
• IT & Tools proficiency: Complete proficiency in Bloomberg (terminal and Excel API), Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid working knowledge of VBA.
• AI proficiency: Confident and effective user of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications) to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency.

• Results orientation: Strong focus on delivering high-quality, actionable outputs and meeting results-based expectations in a demanding investment environment. • Compétences en recherche et en analyse : Fortes capacités de recherche en équité fondamentale avec d'excellentes compétences quantitatives (mais non quantitatives) et une approche fondée sur les premiers principes en matière d'analyse et de communication.

Come Tech Lead in questo team, si costruirà e gestirà la piattaforma, ancorare le decisioni tecniche e sollevare la barra di ingegneria come noi maturano dall'automazione a un prodotto self-service. Your team Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations. The Cloud Platform team operates Pictet’s cloud landing zone and is the partner our engineering teams turn to when they build on it. As cloud adoption grows across Pictet’s engineering community, our goal is to help teams move faster with less friction. As a Tech Lead in this team, you will build and operate the platform, anchor technical decisions and raise the engineering bar as we mature from automation to a self-service product. Your role
• to operate and continuously improve Pictet’s cloud landing zone on AWS and Azure, acting as a trusted technical advisor to the engineers who build on it.
• to give advice on and work with product teams co-build cloud blueprints, turning shared patterns into reusable, self-service building blocks.
• to lead the shift from automation to a self-service platform by designing the paved path and abstraction layer that reduce internal clients’ cognitive load.
• to Act as a Tech Lead by anchoring key design decisions, mentoring engineers and setting the paved-road standards relied on by the team and its internal clients.
• to align with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and provide guidance, and building in security and good practice by default. Your profile
• Strong software engineering skills: you write production-grade code in Python, Go or an equivalent language, and bring the discipline needed to turn automation into a maintainable self-service platform.
• In-depth expertise in infrastructure as code on AWS and/or Azure, with strong Terraform experience and, ideally, exposure to landing-zone or multi-account governance and automation.
• Solid architecture background in identity and access management, networking and integration, with the ability to reason through design choices.
• A platform-as-a-product mindset: you treat internal engineers as clients and care about adoption, self-service and the developer experience.
• Experience as a tech lead or senior individual contributor, making and guiding technical decisions for a team.
• Experience with containers, orchestration and the wider tooling ecosystem, including Kubernetes and GitHub Actions or CI/CD.
• Exposure to DevSecOps, agentic AI or FinOps practices would be an advantage.
• A team player with strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn.
• Fluent English is required; French would be an advantage. Otherwise, candidates should be willing to learn it.
• Swiss resident or willing to relocate. La tua squadra Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato a 31 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo, attualmente con oltre 5.000 persone. Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 220 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà del Partner offre un servizio completo per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare. Ti unirai a Pictet Wealth Management Ginevra e sarai parte del team di revisione AML del cliente con sede lì. Missione Esecuzione di tutte le attività relative al riciclaggio di denaro (AML) con un focus sulla gestione delle recensioni annuali per clienti ad alto rischio e PEP. Il tuo ruolo
• Effettuare un'analisi approfondita del riciclaggio di denaro (AML) per i clienti ad alto rischio in applicazione delle normative in materia di lotta contro il riciclaggio di denaro e il finanziamento del terrorismo (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) e presentando questioni sensibili al Comitato AML.
• Esecuzione di revisioni annuali del PEP in applicazione dei regolamenti sulla lotta contro il riciclaggio di denaro e il finanziamento del terrorismo (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) e presentando le conclusioni al Comitato AML. Il tuo profilo
• Conoscenza approfondita dell'ambiente finanziario e normativo.
• Comprehensive conoscenze legali relative alla conformità.
• Ottimo comando di francese e inglese; altre lingue sarebbero un plus.
• Forte mentalità analitica e capacità di problem solving.
• In grado di comunicare con precisione e distillare informazioni importanti.
• Coscienzioso.
• In grado di mostrare discrezione e gestire questioni riservate in modo appropriato.
• Giocatore di squadra.
• Esperienza di lavoro comprovata da 5 a 10 anni in una posizione simile.
• In grado di gestire gli aspetti materiali e formali delle recensioni KYC/KYT. Ref: BCMR/SN/ET Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro. Applicare Salva lavoro Email a un contatto Torna alla lista

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,000 people. Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 220 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. You will be joining Pictet Wealth Management Geneva and be part of the Client AML Reviewing team based there. Mission Performing all tasks relating to anti-money laundering (AML) with a focus on handling annual reviews for high-risk clients and PEPs. Your role
• Performing in-depth anti-money laundering (AML) analysis for high-risk clients in application of the regulations on the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) and presenting sensitive issues to the AML Committee.
• Performing annual PEP reviews in application of the regulations on the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) and presenting the conclusions to the AML Committee. Your profile
• In-depth knowledge of the financial and regulatory environment.
• Comprehensive legal knowledge relating to compliance.
• Excellent command of French and English; other languages would be a plus.
• Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.
• Able to communicate precisely and distil important information.
• Conscientious.
• Able to show discretion and handle confidential issues in an appropriate manner.
• Team player.
• Proven work experience of 5 to 10 years in a similar position.
• Able to handle the material and formal aspects of KYC/KYT reviews. Ref: BCMR/SN/ET Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Pictet Wealth Management verbindet mehr als 220 Jahre Schweizer Bankerbe mit globaler Investmentexpertise. Die Partner-eigene Finanzdienstleistungsgruppe bietet einen umfassenden Service für wohlhabende Einzelpersonen und Familien, einschließlich diskretionärer und beratender Anlagelösungen und Family Office-Services. Sie werden Pictet Wealth Management Geneva beitreten und Teil des dort ansässigen Customer AML Reviewing Teams sein. Mission Durchführung aller Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit der Bekämpfung der Geldwäsche (AML) mit Schwerpunkt auf der Abwicklung jährlicher Überprüfungen für Kunden mit hohem Risiko und PEPs. Deine Rolle
• Durchführung einer eingehenden Analyse zur Bekämpfung der Geldwäsche (AML) für Kunden mit hohem Risiko in Anwendung der Vorschriften zur Bekämpfung der Geldwäsche und der Finanzierung des Terrorismus (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) und Präsentation sensibler Themen an den AML-Ausschuss.
• Durchführung jährlicher PEP-Überprüfungen in Anwendung der Vorschriften zur Bekämpfung der Geldwäsche und der Terrorismusfinanzierung (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) und Vorlage der Schlussfolgerungen an den AML-Ausschuss. Dein Profil
• Tiefe Kenntnisse des finanziellen und regulatorischen Umfelds.
• Umfassende rechtliche Kenntnisse in Bezug auf Compliance.
• Hervorragende Beherrschung von Französisch und Englisch; andere Sprachen wären ein Plus.
• Starke analytische Denkweise und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.
• Kann präzise kommunizieren und wichtige Informationen destillieren.
• Gewissenhaft.
• Kann Diskretion zeigen und vertrauliche Probleme in angemessener Weise behandeln.
• Teamplayer.
• Nachgewiesene Arbeitserfahrung von 5 bis 10 Jahren in einer ähnlichen Position.
• Kann die materiellen und formalen Aspekte der KYC / KYT-Überprüfungen behandeln. Votre équipe Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Fondé en 1805 et ayant son siège social à Genève, le Groupe est représenté dans 31 bureaux dans les centres financiers du monde entier, employant actuellement plus de 5 000 personnes. Pictet Wealth Management combine plus de 220 ans d'héritage bancaire suisse avec une expertise en investissement mondial. Le groupe de services financiers appartenant aux partenaires offre un service complet aux personnes et aux familles fortunées, y compris des solutions d'investissement discrétionnaires et consultatives et des services de bureau familial. Vous rejoindrez Pictet Wealth Management Geneva et faites partie de l'équipe cliente AML Reviewing basée là-bas. Mission Effectuer toutes les tâches liées à la lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent en mettant l'accent sur le traitement des examens annuels des clients à risque élevé et des PEP. Votre rôle
• Effectuer une analyse approfondie de la lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent pour les clients à haut risque en application des règlements sur la lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent et le financement du terrorisme (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) et présenter des questions sensibles au comité AML.
• Effectuer des examens annuels du PPE en application du règlement relatif à la lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent et le financement du terrorisme (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) et présenter les conclusions au Comité AML. Votre profil
• Connaissance approfondie de l'environnement financier et réglementaire.
• Connaissances juridiques complètes en matière de conformité.
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais; d'autres langues seraient un plus.
• Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
• Capacité à communiquer avec précision et à distiller des informations importantes.
• Conscient.
• Capacité de faire preuve de discrétion et de traiter les questions confidentielles de manière appropriée.
• Joueur d'équipe.
• Expérience professionnelle éprouvée de 5 à 10 ans dans un poste similaire.
• Capacité de gérer le matériel et les aspects formels des revues KYC/KYT. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. We are looking for a dynamic candidate to join the Invoicing, Billing & Payments team . Your role You will ensure proper operational set up to perform this activity as expected by clients and management. This will include making sure organization and processes are efficient, tools are adequate and controls are in place. Acting as a point of contact for ad hoc queries of a pool of mainstream funds clients and front business lines, handling fund suppliers invoices, fund fees payments and monitoring fees budgets implemented by the funds. You will manage the funds fees payments database. You will also be involved in the preparation of fund tax declarations such as VAT, Lux & BE Subscription Tax, tantièmes. You will guarantee service levels and consistently thrive to exceed client’s needs and expectations. Responsibilities:
• Process Fund Suppliers invoices and funds fees payments in a timely manner according to fees calendars and invoice handling deadlines
• Monitor fund fees budgets and manage fees payments database
• Handle client queries relating to fees & payments, liaise with internal and external stakeholders involved in the invoice payment process
• Contribute to the maintenance of procedures and controls as well as the evolution of fees and payments tools to ensure transparency and risk monitoring
• Stay abreast of all internal policies and compliance to legal and regulatory requirements
• Proceed to tax declarations in compliance with the laws and in a timely manner Your profile Educational background and employment experience:
• Experience in funds accounting/ funds fees payments
• Good knowledge of financial products and their valuation
• Broad vision of fund administration Specific knowledge:
• Knowledge of foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques is a plus
• Experience in funds accounting on Multifonds is a plus
• Fund fees payment experience Language knowledge:
• Professional command of English and French Personal qualities:
• Rigorous, organised and good analytical skills
• Adaptability - Can-do attitude, client centric mindset
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn
• Good communication and problem solving
• A team player who is approachable and flexible Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un supporto completo per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri banchieri e altri Specialisti di investimento per costruire partnership di investimento durature e fornire un'esperienza di investimento distintiva su misura per le esigenze di ciascun cliente e le circostanze geografiche. Sosterrai anche i banchieri nei loro sforzi di sviluppo aziendale identificando e presentando le soluzioni di investimento più appropriate e incoraggiando i clienti con account non gestiti a considerare le opzioni attivamente gestite. Stiamo cercando un (Senior) Investment Specialist (m/f/d) per rafforzare il nostro team a Francoforte sul Meno. Il tuo ruolo
• lavorare con i banchieri per identificare e sviluppare nuove opportunità di business all'interno della base clienti esistente e contribuire a iniziative di marketing per aiutare a convertire le prospettive in clienti.
• per aiutare a determinare le esigenze dei clienti e preparare proposte di investimento e consulenza e recensioni di portafoglio.
• eseguire ordini commerciali e confermare l'esecuzione ai clienti, direttamente o tramite assistenti.
• sviluppare, promuovere e mantenere mandati discrezionali, cercando di centralizzare la loro gestione.
• supervisionare i mandati di consulenza, semplificare le posizioni e l'esposizione, e garantire che rimangano coerenti con la strategia globale di investimento della banca e la politica.
• mantenere una forte cultura di conformità e garantire una efficace conformità e gestione dei rischi, aderendo a tutte le pertinenti leggi locali, requisiti normativi, direttive e procedure interne. Il tuo profilo
• Corso di laurea richiesto; una qualifica post-laurea come un master, MBA, CIIA o CFA sarebbe un vantaggio.
• Almeno dieci anni di esperienza nella consulenza di investimento/gestione; l’esperienza di customer-facing è un must.
• Idealmente, l'esperienza tra le classi di asset, con un focus sulle equità, sui derivati e sui prodotti strutturati; la conoscenza degli investimenti alternativi sarebbe un vantaggio.
• Il comando nativo o quasi nativo del tedesco e l'eccellente comando dell'inglese sono richiesti.
• Ottima conoscenza tecnica delle classi di asset, dei veicoli di investimento e delle offerte di mandato discrezionale e consultivo.
• Ottima comprensione della costruzione del portafoglio, dei processi di investimento e degli approcci di gestione del rischio.
• IT-proficienza, compresa la conoscenza di pacchetti software rilevanti, sistemi di informazione online, gestione front-end e sistemi di ordinazione (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, ecc.).
• Forte atteggiamento focalizzato sul cliente e capacità di lavorare sotto pressione.
• Eccellente capacità di presentazione.
• Provato giocatore di squadra con la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente. Nota Offriamo Puoi aspettarti una gamma di compiti varia e responsabile in una banca privata rispettata e in crescita. Inoltre, offriamo una compensazione attraente e benefici sociali completi. Sono inoltre previste opportunità di sviluppo professionale e di formazione ulteriore, e approfittarne è molto apprezzato. Vi diamo il benvenuto per unirsi al nostro team dedicato e motivato! Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers comprehensive support for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. You will work closely with our bankers and fellow Investment Specialists to build lasting investment partnerships and deliver a distinctive investment experience tailored to each client’s needs and geographic circumstances. You will also support bankers in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most appropriate investment solutions and encouraging clients with non-managed accounts to consider actively managed options. We are looking for a (Senior) Investment Specialist (m/f/d) to strengthen our team in Frankfurt am Main. Your role
• to work with bankers to identify and develop new business opportunities within the existing client base and contribute to marketing initiatives to help convert prospects into clients.
• to help determine clients’ needs and prepare investment and advisory proposals and portfolio reviews.
• to execute trade orders and confirm execution to clients, either directly or through assistants.
• to develop, promote and retain discretionary mandates, while seeking to centralise their management.
• to oversee advisory mandates, streamline positions and exposure, and ensure that they remain consistent with the bank’s overall investment strategy and policy.
• to maintain a strong compliance culture and ensure effective compliance and risk management by adhering to all relevant local laws, regulatory requirements, in-house directives and procedures. Your profile
• Bachelor’s degree required; a postgraduate qualification such as a Master’s degree, MBA, CIIA or CFA would be an advantage.
• At least ten years’ experience in investment advisory/management; client-facing experience is a must.
• Ideally, experience across asset classes, with a focus on equities, derivatives and structured products; knowledge of alternative investments would be an advantage.
• Native or near-native command of German and excellent command of English are required.
• Excellent technical knowledge of asset classes, investment vehicles and discretionary and advisory mandate offerings.
• Excellent understanding of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• IT-proficiency, including knowledge of relevant software packages, online information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, etc.).
• Strong client-focused attitude and capacity to work under pressure.
• Excellent presentation skills.
• Proven team player with the ability to work independently. Note We Offer You can expect a varied and responsible range of tasks in a respected and growing private bank. In addition, we offer attractive compensation and comprehensive social benefits. Opportunities for professional development and further training are also provided, and taking advantage of these is highly valued. We welcome you to join our dedicated and motivated team! We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment.
