descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

We are an independent investment partnership known for our long-term mindset, responsible approach to business, and entrepreneurial spirit. These principles have defined us since 1805. For our clients, colleagues and wider society, we always aim to do the right thing and honour our commitment to enduring quality.

Pictet opened its Tokyo office in 1981 to conduct research on the Japanese economy and equity market. It began providing asset management services to institutional investors in 1987 and entered the investment trust (mutual fund) business in 1997. As of the end of March 2026, the firm’s assets under management totaled 4.56 trillion yen.

Your role

We are seeking an economist to lead our global research and analysis on macroeconomics, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange.

Key responsibilities include preparing reports and presentation materials on macroeconomic and financial market developments; delivering presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media; and providing clear explanations and interpretive support during client meetings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills and excellent communication abilities, with the proven ability to convey complex information effectively in both English and Japanese.

Responsibilities

• Conduct in-depth analysis of macroeconomic trends, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange in Japan and globally

• Prepare reports and presentation materials for both internal and external stakeholders

• Deliver presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media

• Provide clear explanations and interpretation support during client meetings

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as an economist

• Deep understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets

• Native-level proficiency in Japanese and business-level or higher proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Excellent report writing and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Certified Member Analyst of the Securities Analysts Association of Japan (CMA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

• Bloomberg

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre équipe Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) est un gestionnaire d'actifs d'investissement de premier plan qui fait partie du groupe Pictet, en mettant l'accent sur les capitaux propres, l'immobilier, l'infrastructure, le crédit privé et les fonds spéculatifs. Pictet Group dispose actuellement de plus de 50 milliards d'AUM en alternatives et de plus de 25 milliards d'AUM en capitaux propres. Pictet a lancé son premier fonds de capital-investissement direct en 2023, en mettant l'accent sur les investissements de rachat européens à moyen terme, ce qui a permis de lever plus de 430 millions d'euros. Le fonds fonctionne à partir de Londres et se concentre sur les investissements dans les sociétés fondatrices et familiales dans les services B2B et l'éducation à travers le Royaume-Uni et les régions DACH. Votre rôle Dans le cadre d'une équipe de 12 professionnels, vous serez responsable des Relations Investisseurs. Vos responsabilités comprendront : • établir et maintenir des relations de travail avec les gestionnaires de relations de gestion de patrimoine de Pictet (PWM) et le personnel commercial de gestion d'actifs (PAM) dans tout le réseau, comprendre leurs livres de clients, leurs priorités de distribution et l'étagère de produits Pictet; • identifier et développer de manière proactive les relations avec les associés en commandite et les perspectives de co-investissement, en tirant parti des relations existantes au sein de Pictet pour le faire; • tenir un calendrier d'engagement régulier des séances d'information sur les produits, des mises à jour du marché, des séances de questions et réponses et des réunions bilatérales avec les partenaires de distribution et les LP; • Gérer les relations de PV au cours du cycle complet du fonds, depuis la première réunion jusqu'à l'engagement, à l'embarquement, à l'établissement de rapports continus et au rétablissement; • connaître le portefeuille de manière suffisamment approfondie pour tenir des conversations détaillées avec les investisseurs sur toute entreprise sans exiger qu'un membre de l'équipe d'investissement senior soit présent; • Posséder tous les matériaux destinés aux investisseurs (pitch deck, DDQ, mises à jour LP, profil de fonds) en étroite collaboration avec l'AAP Marketing et Communications pour assurer la qualité, la cohérence et l'alignement avec les lignes directrices de l'AAP; • Maintenir DealCloud comme record principal des relations et du pipeline LP; utiliser les outils AI (Claude, Copilote) pour la rédaction, la recherche, le suivi des concurrents et la préparation. descriptionByLocale.it: La tua squadra Il Gruppo Pictet è un'azienda leader di asset management indipendente che opera a livello globale. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo mantiene operazioni in 30 sedi in importanti centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, impiegando oltre 4.600 professionisti. Pictet è presente a Singapore da oltre 30 anni, sostenuto da un team superiore a 200 dipendenti. Stiamo cercando un diligente e intuitivo Buy-Side Analyst per aderire al nostro Asia Equity Research team. Sarete responsabili di condurre una ricerca fondamentale approfondita sulle aziende di tutti i settori dei mercati asiatici, con un focus sulle aziende industriali, energetiche e dei consumatori; sviluppare tesi di investimento complete; e fornire raccomandazioni di investimento ad alta concorrenza ai nostri stakeholder interni, in particolare ai responsabili del portafoglio e ai consulenti. Alcune competenze per il settore tecnologico e le sue principali aziende sarebbero vantaggiose. Il tuo ruolo • Ricerca fondamentale: Eseguire ricerche approfondite su aziende, industrie e tendenze macroeconomiche per identificare i valori mobiliari errati; primo focus sulle aziende industriali e dei consumatori. • Modellazione finanziaria: costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari complessi e dinamici per prevedere guadagni e rendimenti futuri. • Raccomandazioni di investimento: Autori di investimento memos e fornire raccomandazioni attuabili a Pictet Wealth Management. • Due diligence: Conduct management interviste, partecipare conferenze del settore, e interagire con gli analisti del settore per raccogliere informazioni proprietarie. • Ricerca potenziata dall'intelligenza artificiale: progettare e applicare strumenti e flussi di lavoro basati sull'intelligenza artificiale per accelerare la generazione dell'idea, migliorare il rilevamento dei modelli e aumentare l'agilità e la scalabilità della ricerca fondamentale. Il tuo profilo • Esperienza: Almeno 6 anni di esperienza di ricerca azionaria sul lato di acquisto o di vendita, idealmente con copertura multi-settore; prima esposizione a un istituto finanziario leader è un vantaggio forte. • Competenze linguistiche: comando eccellente di inglese scritto e parlato (nativo o equivalente) e comando fluente o migliore del mandarino scritto e parlato in quanto il ruolo richiede frequenti ricerche e comunicazioni che coinvolgono aziende cinesi e fonti di lingua mandarino • Ricerca e competenze analitiche: forti capacità fondamentali di ricerca azionaria con eccellenti competenze quantitative (ma non quantitative) e un approccio basato su principi all'analisi e alla comunicazione. • Abilità di comunicazione e presentazione: eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritta (memoria di investimento, note di ricerca) e eccellenti capacità di presentazione per trasmettere idee complesse in modo chiaro e convincente. • Proficienza IT & Tools: Completa competenza in Bloomberg (terminal e Excel API), Microsoft Excel e PowerPoint; solida conoscenza di lavoro di VBA. • Competenza dell'intelligenza artificiale: utente sicuro ed efficace degli strumenti AI (ad esempio ChatGPT, Claude e applicazioni simili) per migliorare la produttività della ricerca, la generazione di informazioni e l'efficienza del flusso di lavoro. • Qualità personali: personalità indipendente, intuitiva, auto-avviamento con un forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità, pur essendo un giocatore di squadra. • Orientamento dei risultati: Forte attenzione a fornire prodotti di alta qualità, attuabili e soddisfare le aspettative basate sui risultati in un ambiente di investimento esigente. descriptionByLocale.en: Your team The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. Pictet has been present in Singapore for over 30 years, supported by a team exceeding 200 employees. We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Asia Equity Research team. You will be responsible for conducting in-depth fundamental research on companies across sectors in Asian markets, with a focus on industrial, energy, and consumer companies; developing comprehensive investment theses; and providing high-conviction investment recommendations to our internal stakeholders, in particular portfolio managers and advisors. Some expertise to the technology sector and its major companies would be beneficial. Your role • Fundamental research: Perform deep-dive research into companies, industries, and macroeconomic trends to identify mispriced securities; initial focus on Industrial and Consumer companies. • Financial modelling: Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns. • Investment recommendations: Author investment memos and deliver actionable recommendations to Pictet Wealth Management. • Due diligence: Conduct management interviews, attend industry conferences, and interact with sell-side analysts to gather proprietary insights. • AI-augmented research: Design and apply AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate idea generation, enhance pattern detection, and increase the agility and scalability of fundamental research. Your profile • Experience: At least 6 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, ideally with multi-sector coverage; prior exposure to a leading financial institution is a strong plus. • Language skills: Excellent command of written and spoken English (native or equivalent) and fluent or better command of written and spoken Mandarin as the role requires frequent research and communication involving Chinese companies and Mandarin-language sources • Research & Analytical Skills: Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative (but non-quant) skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication. • Communication & Presentation Skills: Outstanding written communication skills (investment memos, research notes) and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly. • IT & Tools proficiency: Complete proficiency in Bloomberg (terminal and Excel API), Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid working knowledge of VBA. • AI proficiency: Confident and effective user of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications) to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency. • Personal qualities: Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, while being a team player. • Results orientation: Strong focus on delivering high-quality, actionable outputs and meeting results-based expectations in a demanding investment environment. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. descriptionByLocale.en: Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,000 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 25 years where it employs over 200 people. Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services. Your role We are seeking a highly motivated Financial Analyst to join our Asia 2 team as part of a unique, structured 4-year rotational programme designed to provide a comprehensive foundation in private banking and investment management. At the end of this programme, you will be equipped to take on the role of Private Banker, supported by a robust in-house network of specialists and an understanding of our business and clients. This permanent position offers a 48-month journey through three key areas of our Wealth Management business, allowing you to build expertise and develop a strong professional network: • Year 1: Immersion with Client Relationship Officers to discover client relationship management and daily operations. • Years 2 & 3: Integration within the Investment Platform to deepen your knowledge of investment and portfolio management, and to understand the needs of portfolio managers. • Year 4: Gaining practical experience in high-level wealth management advisory through the management of an existing client portfolio. Con team basati a livello globale, PAA costruisce, gestisce e consiglia portafogli di soluzioni di investimento alternative per clienti istituzionali e privati. Sarete parte di un team che copre il ciclo di vita completo dei dipendenti PAA a livello globale. Il team HR svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel reclutamento, nello sviluppo professionale e personale dei dipendenti e nel facilitare le operazioni diurne. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con professionisti esperti che ti guideranno nella comprensione delle complessità della gestione delle risorse umane all'interno di un istituto finanziario. Questo ambiente vi offrirà approfondimenti pratici e preziose esperienze pratiche in vari aspetti e contatti in tutta la comunità delle risorse umane in Svizzera ma anche al di fuori del paese (principalmente Londra, Lussemburgo e Singapore). Il tuo ruolo Fornire un supporto amministrativo essenziale al team. Le tue responsabilità includono:
• Documenti di redazione: Preparare e pubblicare annunci di lavoro (internamente ed esternamente), stabilire riferimenti di lavoro e contratti sia in inglese che in francese.
• Gestione dei dati: Mantenere registri dei dipendenti accurati e dati amministrativi all'interno dei nostri sistemi HR.
• Reclutamento: Organizzazione di interviste in-persona e online con candidati internazionali e gestione dell'imbarco di nuovi dipendenti.
• Sostegno amministrativo: Assistere con vari compiti amministrativi relativi al reclutamento, pianificazione di riunioni interne e altre iniziative HR. Il tuo profilo
• Attualmente perseguire o hanno recentemente completato una laurea o un CFC in Risorse Umane, Business Administration o un campo correlato. Il certificato di assistente delle risorse umane sarebbe un bene.
• L'esperienza precedente in un ambiente di lavoro esigente sarà un bene.
• Proattivi e capaci di lavorare autonomamente e con scadenze strette.

With teams based globally, PAA constructs, manages and advises portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. You will be part of a team covering the full life cycle of PAA employees globally. • Proactive and capable of working autonomously and under tight deadlines.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, with strong capabilities in organising data and preparing presentations.
• English or French mother tongue, with a perfect command of the other language both spoken and written.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments. The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework. Your role
• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.
• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.
• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.
• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.
• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.
• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.
• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.
• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.
• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests. Your profile Please insert the text for the job ad to be then published internally/externally Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. As part of the Client Register team , you will contribute to the management and integrity of client data, supporting the bank’s core operations and ensuring a high standard of service for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams, without direct contact with clients. Your main responsibilities will include managing the opening and closing of customer accounts for the bank and its branches, as well as handling credit card administration for customers. This involves updating static data and the services selected by our clients and performing “Cotation” tasks such as signature verification. In addition, you will play a central role in the transformation of our activities by driving the identification, implementation, and optimization of automation and digitalization solutions for our processes. You will ensure strict adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements, while supporting the various business lines of the Bank. Your role
• Play a key role in managing client account openings and updates for individuals, legal entities, and trusts, ensuring a seamless client experience.
• Strive for excellence in data quality and completeness, supporting both business growth and regulatory requirements.
• Take charge of credit card administration, working closely with service providers to deliver efficient solutions.
• Perform analysis of account structures and verification of client signatures to ensure the validity and compliance of payment instructions.
• Make a real impact by contributing to data remediation initiatives and maintaining accurate client records.
• Be proactive in improving departmental procedures, keeping us aligned with the latest industry standards.
• Embrace digital transformation by supporting the adoption of automation and AI solutions.
• Foster consistency and efficiency by promoting process harmonization across the Group.
• Get involved in projects that drive innovation and enhance client data management.
• Collaborate with dedicated colleagues and key stakeholders across the business.
• Be a valued partner, responding to requests from all business lines regarding Client Register activities. Your profile Requested experience:
• Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree, ideally complemented by initial experience in the banking sector (Operations) Soft skills:
• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.
• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.
• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism. Technical skills:
• Proficient in standard MS Office products.
• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset. Language skills:
• Fluent in written and spoken French. Good command of English. German is an asset. Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo, attualmente impiegando oltre 5000 persone. Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) gestisce i beni di alcune delle più grandi istituzioni, intermediari finanziari e clienti del mondo. La nostra cultura accoglie pensatori e centri indipendenti intorno all'eccellenza degli investimenti, una prospettiva a lungo termine e una dedizione al servizio clienti. Il tuo ruolo Il team ESG Research & Analytics fa parte del dipartimento Investment Risk & Data Analytics e collabora con i team di investimento di Pictet AM, il team Responsible Investing e altri stakeholder interni ed esterni con l'obiettivo di continuare a rafforzare il rischio ESG e la gestione dei dati all'interno dei processi di investimento. Sarete responsabili di testare e convalidare nuovi flussi di lavoro per la fornitura di dati sostenibili, garantendo robustezza, coerenza e scalabilità. Contribuirai alla progettazione e all'implementazione dei controlli di qualità dei dati su più set di dati ESG, incluso il monitoraggio della completezza dei dati, accuratezza e tempestività. Sosterrai il miglioramento e la manutenzione dei modelli ESG esistenti utilizzati per analizzare le esposizioni ambientali e sociali per i fondi classificati, garantendo l'integrità dei dati e la coerenza metodologica in tutte le classi di asset. Contribuirai alla governance dei dati ESG documentando le definizioni dei dati, il lignaggio e i controlli e garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di dati interni e i framework dei metadati. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i gestori di portafoglio, i team di investimento e altri stakeholder per supportare l'integrazione dei criteri ESG nei processi decisionali di investimento. Infine, si condurrÃ l'esplorazione e l'analisi dei dati per generare intuizioni a valore aggiunto e parteciperÃ attivamente alla validazione e alla sfida dei fornitori di dati ESG e metodologie. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea universitaria: laurea magistrale una disciplina quantitativa/scientifica (ad esempio Statistica, Informatica o Ingegneria) o in Finanza è preferito.
• Keen interesse per la finanza sostenibile, principi ESG con la capacità di contribuire applicando i nuovi approcci e tecnologie apprese durante i vostri studi.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers comprehensive support for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will work closely with our bankers and fellow Investment Specialists to build lasting investment partnerships and deliver a distinctive investment experience tailored to each client’s needs and geographic circumstances. You will also support bankers in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most appropriate investment solutions and encouraging clients with non-managed accounts to consider actively managed options.

We are looking for a (Senior) Investment Specialist (m/f/d) to strengthen our team in Frankfurt am Main.

Your role

• to work with bankers to identify and develop new business opportunities within the existing client base and contribute to marketing initiatives to help convert prospects into clients.
• to help determine clients’ needs and prepare investment and advisory proposals and portfolio reviews.
• to execute trade orders and confirm execution to clients, either directly or through assistants.
• to develop, promote and retain discretionary mandates, while seeking to centralise their management.
• to oversee advisory mandates, streamline positions and exposure, and ensure that they remain consistent with the bank’s overall investment strategy and policy.
• to maintain a strong compliance culture and ensure effective compliance and risk management by adhering to all relevant local laws, regulatory requirements, in-house directives and procedures.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree required; a postgraduate qualification such as a Master’s degree, MBA, CIIA or CFA would be an advantage.
• At least ten years’ experience in investment advisory/management; client-facing experience is a must.
• Ideally, experience across asset classes, with a focus on equities, derivatives and structured products; knowledge of alternative investments would be an advantage.
• Native or near-native command of German and excellent command of English are required.
• Excellent technical knowledge of asset classes, investment vehicles and discretionary and advisory mandate offerings.
• Excellent understanding of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• IT-proficiency, including knowledge of relevant software packages, online information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, etc.).
• Strong client-focused attitude and capacity to work under pressure.
• Excellent presentation skills.
• Proven team player with the ability to work independently.

Note

We Offer
You can expect a varied and responsible range of tasks in a respected and growing private bank. In addition, we offer attractive compensation and comprehensive social benefits. Opportunities for professional development and further training are also provided, and taking advantage of these is highly valued.

We welcome you to join our dedicated and motivated team!

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch.

The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead.

Your role

Key responsibilities

-Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities.
-Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews.
-Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls.
-Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting).
-Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management.
-Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance.
-Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients.
-Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives.
-Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews.
-Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks.
-Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management.
-Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations.
-Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned.

Your profile

-Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business.
-Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework.
-Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role.
-6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations.
-Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous.
-Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills.

-Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
-Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders.
-Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines.

Die Compliance-Funktion ist dafür verantwortlich, die Geschäftsleitung von Pictet bei der Steuerung der Compliance-Risiken zu unterstützen, denen Pictet ausgesetzt ist. Diese Rolle wird sich auf die Risiken konzentrieren, denen die Pictet-Bank in Singapur, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch, ausgesetzt ist.

Der AML/CFT Compliance Officer ist Teil des Teams, das den Rahmen für Finanzkriminalität der Bank überwacht, der sich hauptsächlich auf die Einhaltung von AML/CFT und Sanktionen konzentriert. Der etablierte Betreiber führt systematische AML / CFT-Überprüfungen bei Kunden mit hohem Risiko vor dem Onboarding und anschließende regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch, überprüft Warnungen / Probleme, die durch First-Line-Funktionen eskaliert wurden, und meldet Verdacht auf kriminelle oder sanktionierte Aktivitäten und berät über AML / CFT und Sanktionsmanagement. Der leitende Angestellte überwacht Änderungen, die sich auf das Unternehmen auswirken können, und arbeitet mit Geschäfts- und Unterstützungsfunktionen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Bank die regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Gruppenstandards im Bereich der Finanzkriminalität einhält. Die Rolle wird an den Compliance AML Lead berichten.

Deine Rolle

Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten

-Untersuchen Sie relevante Warnungen und verdächtige Aktivitäten und führen Sie die Einreichung von STR an lokale Behörden durch.
Führen Sie Ex-ante-AML-Bewertungen zum Onboarding von Kunden mit hohem Risiko und regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch.
-Überprüfung eskalierter Warnmeldungen aus der First-Line-Transaktionsüberwachung, Zahlungsfilterung und laufenden Kontrolle der Namensüberprüfung.
Support externe Anfragen umfassen Produktionsaufträge, Due Diligence Anfragen und alle relevanten regulatorischen Berichte (z. B. Remote Gambling Act Reporting).
Als kompetenter Berater für Geschäfts- und Unterstützungsfunktionen in Compliance- und Regulierungsfragen im Zusammenhang mit AML / CFT und internationalem Sanktionsmanagement fungieren.
Führen Sie eine jährliche AML / CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) durch, um Risiken und Rahmen- / Kontrolllücken für das Management und die Gruppen-Compliance zu identifizieren.
Unterstützung bei regelmäßigen risikobasierten Design- und Betriebseffektivitätstests von First-Line-AML/CFT-Kontrollen, einschließlich bei Kunden mit geringerem Risiko.
-Repräsentieren Sie bei Bedarf Compliance bei Projekten und Initiativen im Zusammenhang mit Finanzkriminalität.
Unterstützung bei der Lösung von Compliance-eigenen Management-Aktionsplänen aus Audits, Inspektionen und Gruppenbewertungen.
Erstellen Sie relevante Management-Informationsberichte an den Vorstand und die Geschäftsleitung über die Governance von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken.
Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung einer proaktiven und konstruktiven Beziehung zu Unternehmen und funktionalen Stakeholdern, um sicherzustellen, dass angemessene Kontrollen für die Identifizierung und das Management von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken vorhanden sind.
-Halten Sie sich auf dem Laufenden und verstehen Sie die Auswirkungen neuer Vorschriften für Finanzkriminalität und vertreten Sie die Bank bei Bedarf in Branchenberatungen.
Unterstützen Sie den AML-Lead in Singapur bei allen AML/CFT-Angelegenheiten und allen anderen zugewiesenen Aufgaben.

Dein Profil

Bachelor-Abschluss in Law, Banking oder Business.
Kenntnisse der CDSA, der AML/CFT-Typologien, der einschlägigen MAS-Verordnungen und der Leitlinien für AML/CFT und des internationalen Sanktionsrahmens.
-Arbeitserfahrung in Singapur Regulierungslandschaft und Erwartungen erforderlich. Vertrautheit mit Vorschriften und Leitlinien in einer AML, Financial Crime Compliance Rolle.
-6-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der AML / CFT-Compliance, insbesondere in Untersuchungen.
-Vorherige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Privatbank wird von Vorteil sein.

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Pictet est présent à Singapour depuis plus de 30 ans et emploie plus de 200 personnes.

La fonction Conformité est chargée d'aider la haute direction de Pictet à gérer les risques de conformité auxquels elle fait face. Ce rôle sera axé sur les risques auxquels est confrontée la banque de Singapour Pictet, la Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) la succursale de Singapour.

L'agent de conformité de la LAM/FT fait partie de l'équipe qui supervise le cadre de criminalité financière de la Banque, principalement axé sur la LAM/FT et le respect des sanctions. Le titulaire effectue des examens systématiques de la LMA/FT sur les clients à risque élevé avant d'être à bord et les examens périodiques subséquents, examine les alertes/questions aggravées par les fonctions de première ligne et signale les soupçons d'activités criminelles ou sanctionnées, et fournit des conseils sur la LMA/FT et la gestion des sanctions. L'agent surveille les changements qui peuvent avoir une incidence sur l'entreprise, en travaillant avec les fonctions d'affaires et de soutien pour s'assurer que la Banque respecte les obligations réglementaires et les normes du Groupe dans le domaine de la criminalité financière. Ce rôle fera rapport au responsable de la LMA.

Votre rôle

Principales responsabilités

-Inspecter les alertes pertinentes et les activités suspectes, et effectuer le dépôt de la DOD auprès des autorités locales.
- Effectuer des examens ex ante de la LMA sur les clients à risque élevé à bord et des examens périodiques.
-L'examen a augmenté les alertes provenant de la surveillance des transactions de première ligne, du filtrage des paiements et des contrôles permanents de contrôle des noms.
-Les demandes externes de soutien comprennent les ordonnances de production, les demandes de diligence raisonnable et tout rapport réglementaire pertinent (p. ex., la Loi sur le jeu à distance).
-Faire office de conseiller expert auprès des entreprises et des fonctions d'appui sur les questions de conformité et de réglementation liées à la LMA/FT et à la gestion des sanctions internationales.
- Effectuer une évaluation annuelle des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise (EWRA) de la LMA/FT, qui identifie les risques et le cadre ou les lacunes en matière de contrôle à l'attention de la direction et du Groupe - Conformité.
-Assister à la conception périodique fondée sur le risque et à l'évaluation de l'efficacité opérationnelle des contrôles de première ligne de LMA/FT, y compris sur les clients à faible risque.
-Représenter le respect, au besoin, des projets et initiatives liés à la criminalité financière.
-Assister à la résolution des plans d'action de la gestion de la conformité des audits, des inspections et des examens de groupe.
-Produire des rapports d'information de gestion pertinents au conseil d'administration et à la haute direction sur la gouvernance des risques de criminalité financière.
-Construire et maintenir une relation proactive et constructive avec les intervenants opérationnels et fonctionnels afin de s'assurer que des contrôles appropriés sont en place pour l'identification et la gestion des risques de criminalité financière.
-Garder au courant et comprendre l'impact des nouveaux règlements sur la criminalité financière et, au besoin, représenter la Banque dans les consultations de l'industrie.
-Soutenir la direction de la LMA de Singapour sur toutes les questions relatives à la LMA/FT et sur toutes les autres tâches assignées.

- Baccalauréat en droit, banque ou affaires.
-Connaissance de la CDSA, des typologies AML/CFT, du Règlement MAS pertinent et des Directives sur la LAM/CFT et le cadre des sanctions internationales.
- Expérience de travail du paysage réglementaire de Singapour et attentes nécessaires. Connaissance des règlements et des directives dans le cadre d'une LMA, Crime financier Rôle de conformité.
-6 à 10 ans d'expérience pertinente en matière de conformité à la LAM/FT, en particulier en ce qui concerne les enquêtes.
-L'expérience antérieure dans un rôle similaire dans une banque privée sera avantageuse.

Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 5200 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit 1989 in Luxemburg präsent und beschäftigt dort über 700 Mitarbeiter.

FundPartner Solutions bietet eine vollständige Suite von Fondsverwaltungs- und Private-Label-Fondsdiensten. Das globale Team von Branchenexperten ist spezialisiert auf Fondsdomizilierung, Registrierung und Governance sowie Risk Compliance und Investment Management Services.

Die Division Pictet Tech ist spezialisiert auf die Entwicklung und Integration modernster Softwareanwendungen, einschließlich fortschrittlicher Portfoliomanagementsysteme, anspruchsvoller Handelsplattformen und umfassender Bank- und Unternehmenslösungen. Als wichtiger Beitrag zu den strategischen Weiterentwicklungen der Gruppe spielt die Division eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Förderung transformativer Innovationen, die unsere Dienstleistungen verbessern und unseren Kunden einen außergewöhnlichen Mehrwert bieten.

Der Technical Business Analyst fungiert als Brücke zwischen Business Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteams und unterstützt die Fondsplattform mit besonderem Fokus auf Transfer Agency (TA) Prozesse. Die Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, Geschäftsanforderungen zu verstehen, zu analysieren und in effektive technische Lösungen zu übersetzen, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Geschäftsanalysepraktiken sicherzustellen und zum Gesamterfolg der Plattform in der Fondsbranche beizutragen.

Deine Rolle

• Arbeiten Sie mit Experten und Stakeholdern für Geschäftsthemen zusammen, um Geschäftsanforderungen für die Fondsplattform zu sammeln, zu analysieren und zu dokumentieren, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf den Prozessen und Operationen von Transfer Agency (TA) liegt.

• Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare IT-Anforderungen, User Stories und Testszenarien mit agilen Methoden und Jira.

• Vorschlag und Bewertung von Lösungsoptionen in Abstimmung mit Lösungsarchitekten unter Berücksichtigung bestehender Systeme, Software und Marktinnovationen (einschließlich KI).

• Erstellen und pflegen Sie eine umfassende Dokumentation, einschließlich Spezifikationen, Prozessabläufe und Benutzerhandbücher.

• Führen Sie bei Bedarf Projektmanagementaktivitäten, einschließlich der Koordination der Stakeholder, der Besprechungserleichterungen und der Meilensteinverfolgung.

• Datenanalyse durchführen und datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen.

• Sicherstellung der Ausführung und Bereitstellung von IT-Projekten in Übereinstimmung mit Geschäftsanforderungen, Zeitplänen und Qualitätsstandards.

• Führen Sie funktionale Akzeptanztests durch, analysieren Sie Produktionsvorfälle und unterstützen Sie Benutzer während und nach der Implementierung.

• Beitrag zu Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen durch die Gestaltung und Implementierung effizienter Workflows während Systemänderungen oder Migrationen, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf Innovation und Optimierung gegenüber der Replikation von Legacy-Prozessen liegt

• Aktiv als Mitglied des Business Analyst Chapter teilnehmen; Hare Wissen, Best Practices, und treiben die Entwicklung der Business-Analyse-Disziplin innerhalb des Kapitels

Dein Profil

• Min. 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Bank als Business Analyst

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als Business Analyst oder Technical Business Analyst in der Fondsbranche, mit einem starken Fokus auf Transferagenturprozesse.

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten; in der Lage, Meetings und Workshops zu erleichtern.

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten und Ergebnisse in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu liefern

• Projektmanagement-Erfahrung, einschließlich der Organisation und Leitung von funktionsübergreifenden Meetings.

• Fließend in Englisch, Französisch ist ein Asset

• Vertiefte Kenntnis der Funktionen von Transferagenturen, einschließlich Anlegerservice, Transaktionsverarbeitung und damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.

• Erfahrung mit Branchenplattformen und Tools, die für Transferagenturen relevant sind (z. B. Multifonds TA, Fenergo); Erfahrung mit Systemintegrationen und Datenmigrationen ist ein Plus.

• Kenntnisse in SQL für Datenanalyse und Fehlersuche

• Erfahrung in agilen Umgebungen mit praktischer Nutzung von JIRA (und Confluence) für Story Management und Projekt-Tracking.

• Fähigkeit, klare, strukturierte Dokumentationen und User Stories zu schreiben.

• Vertrautheit mit KI-Tools und deren Anwendung in der Geschäftsanalyse; Erfahrung bei der Implementierung von KI-gesteuerten Lösungen ist ein Plus.

Votre équipe

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Fondé en 1805 et ayant son siège social à Genève, le Groupe est représenté dans 30 bureaux dans les centres financiers du monde entier et emploie actuellement plus de 5200 personnes. Pictet est présent depuis 1989 au Luxembourg, où il emploie plus de 700 personnes.

FundPartner Solutions offre une gamme complète de services d'administration de fonds et de fonds de marques privées. L'équipe mondiale d'experts de l'industrie se spécialise dans la domiciliation des fonds, l'enregistrement et la gouvernance, ainsi que dans la conformité aux risques et les services de gestion des investissements.

La division Pictet Tech se spécialise dans la conception et l'intégration d'applications logicielles de pointe, y compris des systèmes de gestion de portefeuille avancés, des plateformes de négociation sophistiquées et des solutions bancaires et corporatives complètes. En tant que facteur clé des avancées stratégiques du Groupe, la division joue un rôle vital dans la conduite d'innovations transformatrices qui améliorent nos services et offrent une valeur exceptionnelle à nos clients.

L'analyste technique des affaires sert de pont entre les parties prenantes et les équipes de développement, appuyant la plate-forme des fonds en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les processus des organismes de transfert. Le rôle est de comprendre, d'analyser et de traduire les besoins des entreprises en solutions techniques efficaces, d'assurer l'amélioration continue des pratiques d'analyse commerciale et de contribuer au succès global de la plateforme au sein de l'industrie des fonds.

Votre rôle

• Collaborer avec des experts en affaires et des intervenants afin de recueillir, d'analyser et de documenter les exigences opérationnelles de la plateforme de financement, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les processus et les opérations des organismes de transfert.

• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en exigences informatiques claires et réalisables, en récits d'utilisateurs et en scénarios de test utilisant les méthodologies Agile et Jira.

• Proposer et évaluer les options de solutions en coordination avec les architectes de solutions, en tenant compte des systèmes existants, des logiciels et des innovations du marché (y compris l'IA).

• Préparer et tenir à jour une documentation complète, y compris des spécifications, des flux de processus et des guides d'utilisation.

• Diriger les activités de gestion de projet au besoin, y compris la coordination des intervenants, la facilitation des réunions et le suivi des étapes.

• Effectuer une analyse des données et appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les données.

• Assurer l'exécution et l'exécution des projets de TI conformément aux exigences opérationnelles, aux échéanciers et aux normes de qualité.

• Effectuer des essais d'acceptation fonctionnelle, analyser les incidents de production et soutenir les utilisateurs pendant et après la mise en œuvre.

• Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration des processus en concevant et en mettant en œuvre des flux de travail efficaces pendant les changements ou les migrations de systèmes, en mettant l'accent sur l'innovation et l'optimisation de la réplication des processus hérités

• Participation active en tant que membre du chapitre sur l'analyse des affaires; connaissances, pratiques exemplaires et orientation de la discipline d'analyse des affaires dans le chapitre

Votre profil

• Min 5 ans d'expérience dans une banque comme Analyste d'affaires

• Expérience éprouvée en tant qu'analyste d'affaires ou analyste technique d'affaires dans l'industrie des fonds, en mettant l'accent sur les processus des organismes de transfert.

• Excellente capacité de communication et de gestion des intervenants; capable de faciliter les réunions et les ateliers.

• Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de produire des résultats dans un environnement dynamique

• Expérience en gestion de projet, y compris l'organisation et la conduite de réunions interfonctionnelles.

• Fluent en anglais, le français est un atout

• Connaissance approfondie des fonctions des organismes de transfert, y compris le service aux investisseurs, le traitement des transactions et les exigences réglementaires connexes.

• Expérience des plates-formes industrielles et des outils pertinents pour l'agence de transfert (p. ex., TA Multifonds, Fenergo); l'expérience des intégrations de systèmes et des migrations de données est un atout.

• Compétence en SQL pour l'analyse des données et le dépannage

• Expérience de travail dans des environnements agiles, avec utilisation pratique de JIRA (et Confluence) pour la gestion des histoires et le suivi des projets.

• Capacité d'écrire une documentation claire et structurée et des histoires d'utilisateurs.

• Familiarisation avec les outils d'IA et leur application dans l'analyse d'affaires; l'expérience de la mise en œuvre des solutions d'IA est un plus.

Remarque

Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire des agences

Diversité et inclusion

Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons toutes les personnes et nous cherchons à les inclure dans le milieu de travail.

Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 sedi in centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, e attualmente impiega oltre 5200 persone. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone. FundPartner Solutions offre una suite completa di servizi di gestione fondi e private label. Il team globale di esperti del settore si specializza nella domiciliazione dei fondi, registrazione e governance, così come nel rispetto dei rischi e nei servizi di gestione degli investimenti. La divisione Pictet Tech è specializzata nella progettazione e integrazione di applicazioni software all'avanguardia, tra cui sistemi avanzati di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di trading sofisticate e soluzioni bancarie e aziendali complete. La divisione svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella guida delle innovazioni trasformative che migliorano i nostri servizi e offrono un valore eccezionale ai nostri clienti. Il Technical Business Analyst funge da ponte tra gli stakeholder aziendali e i team di sviluppo, supportando la Piattaforma dei Fondi con particolare attenzione ai processi Transfer Agency (TA). Il ruolo è responsabile della comprensione, dell'analisi e della traduzione delle esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche efficaci, garantendo il continuo miglioramento delle pratiche di analisi aziendale e contribuendo al successo complessivo della piattaforma nell'industria dei fondi. Il tuo ruolo
• Collaborare con esperti e stakeholder aziendali per raccogliere, analizzare e documentare i requisiti aziendali per la piattaforma dei fondi, con particolare attenzione ai processi e alle operazioni di Transfer Agency (TA).
• Tradurre le esigenze di business in requisiti IT chiari e attuabili, storie utente e scenari di test utilizzando metodologie Agile e Jira.
• Proporre e valutare le opzioni di soluzione in coordinamento con gli architetti di soluzioni, considerando i sistemi esistenti, i software e le innovazioni di mercato (inclusa l'IA).
• Preparare e mantenere la documentazione completa, comprese le specifiche, i flussi di processo e le guide degli utenti.
• Guidare le attività di gestione dei progetti, tra cui il coordinamento delle parti interessate, la facilitazione delle riunioni e il monitoraggio delle pietre miliari.
• Condurre l'analisi dei dati e supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati.
• Assicurare l'esecuzione e la consegna di progetti IT in linea con i requisiti aziendali, le linee temporali e gli standard di qualità.
• Eseguire test di accettazione funzionali, analizzare gli incidenti di produzione e supportare gli utenti durante e dopo l'implementazione.
• Contribuire alle iniziative di miglioramento del processo progettando e implementando flussi di lavoro efficienti durante i cambiamenti di sistema o le migrazioni, concentrandosi sull'innovazione e l'ottimizzazione sulla replica dei processi legacy
• Partecipa attivamente come membro del capitolo Business Analyst; s hare conoscenza, best practice e guidare l'evoluzione della disciplina di analisi aziendale all'interno del capitolo Il tuo profilo
• Min 5 anni di esperienza in una banca come Business Analyst
• Provata esperienza come Business Analyst o Technical Business Analyst nel settore dei fondi, con una forte attenzione ai processi di agenzia di trasferimento.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder; in grado di facilitare riunioni e workshop.
• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving.
• Capacità di gestire più priorità e fornire risultati in un ambiente dinamico
• Esperienza di gestione del progetto, compresa l'organizzazione e le principali riunioni interfunzionali.
• Fluente in inglese, il francese è un bene
• Conoscenza approfondita delle funzioni dell'agenzia di trasferimento, inclusa la manutenzione degli investitori, il trattamento delle transazioni e i relativi requisiti normativi.
• Esperienza con piattaforme e strumenti di settore rilevanti per l'agenzia di trasferimento (ad esempio, Multifonds TA, Fenergo); l'esperienza con integrazioni di sistema e migrazioni di dati è un vantaggio.
• Proficienza in SQL per l'analisi dei dati e la risoluzione dei problemi
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti Agile, con uso pratico di JIRA (e Confluence) per la gestione delle storie e il monitoraggio dei progetti.
• Capacità di scrivere documentazione chiara e strutturata e storie utente.
• Familiarità con gli strumenti AI e la loro applicazione nell'analisi aziendale; l'esperienza di implementare soluzioni basate su AI è un vantaggio. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients. The Technical Business Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, supporting the Funds Platform with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes. The role is responsible for understanding, analyzing, and translating business needs into effective technical solutions, ensuring the continuous improvement of business analysis practices and contributing to the overall success of the platform within the funds industry. Your role
• Collaborate with business subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for the funds platform, with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes and operations.
• Translate business needs into clear, actionable IT requirements, user stories, and test scenarios using Agile methodologies and Jira.
• Propose and evaluate solution options in coordination with solution architects, considering existing systems, software, and market innovations (including AI).
• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including specifications, process flows, and user guides.
• Lead project management activities as necessary, including stakeholder coordination, meeting facilitation, and milestone tracking.
• Conduct data analysis and support data-driven decision-making.
• Ensure the execution and delivery of IT projects in line with business requirements, timelines, and quality standards.
• Carry out functional acceptance testing, analyze production incidents, and support users during and after implementation.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by designing and implementing efficient workflows during system changes or migrations, focusing on innovation and optimization over replication of legacy processes
• Actively participate as a member of the Business Analyst Chapter; s hare knowledge, best practices, and drive the evolution of the business analysis discipline within the chapter Your profile
• Min 5 years experience in a bank as Business Analyst
• Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the funds industry, with a strong focus on transfer agency processes.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to facilitate meetings and workshops.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment
• Project management experience, including organizing and leading cross-functional meetings.
• Fluent in English, French is an asset
• In-depth knowledge of transfer agency functions, including investor servicing, transaction processing, and related regulatory requirements.
• Experience with industry platforms and tools relevant to transfer agency (e.g., Multifonds TA, Fenergo); experience with system integrations and data migrations is a plus.
• Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting
• Experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on use of JIRA (and Confluence) for story management and project tracking.
• Ability to write clear, structured documentation and user stories.
• Familiarity with AI tools and their application in business analysis; experience implementing AI-driven solutions is a plus. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people. The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch. The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead. Your role Key responsibilities -Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities. -Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews. -Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls. -Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting). -Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management. -Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance. -Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients. -Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives. -Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews. -Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks. -Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management. -Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations. -Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned. Your profile -Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business. -Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework. -Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role. -6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations. -Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous. -Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills. -Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. -Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders. -Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines. Diese Rolle wird sich auf die Risiken der Pictet-Bank in Singapur, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch, konzentrieren. Der AML/CFT Compliance Officer ist Teil des Teams, das den Finanzkriminalitätsrahmen der Bank überwacht, der sich hauptsächlich auf die Einhaltung von AML/CFT und Sanktionen konzentriert. Der etablierte Betreiber führt systematische AML / CFT-Überprüfungen bei Kunden mit hohem Risiko vor dem Onboarding und anschließende regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch, überprüft Warnungen / Probleme, die durch Erstlinienfunktionen eskaliert wurden, und meldet Verdacht auf kriminelle oder sanktionierte Aktivitäten und berät Sie zum AML / CFT- und Sanktionsmanagement. Der leitende Angestellte überwacht Änderungen, die sich auf das Geschäft auswirken können, und arbeitet mit Geschäfts- und Unterstützungsfunktionen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Bank die regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Gruppenstandards im Bereich der Finanzkriminalität einhält. Die Rolle wird an den Compliance AML Lead berichten. Führen Sie Ex-ante-AML-Bewertungen zum Onboarding von Kunden mit hohem Risiko und regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch. -Überprüfung eskalierter Warnmeldungen aus der First-Line-Transaktionsüberwachung, Zahlungsfilterung und laufenden Kontrolle der Namensüberprüfung. Support externe Anfragen umfassen Produktionsaufträge, Due Diligence Anfragen und alle relevanten regulatorischen Berichte (z. B. Remote Gambling Act Reporting). Als fachkundiger Berater für Geschäfts- und Supportfunktionen in Compliance- und Regulierungsfragen im Zusammenhang mit AML / CFT und internationalem Sanktionsmanagement fungieren. Führen Sie eine jährliche AML / CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) durch, um Risiken und Rahmen- / Kontrolllücken für das Management und die Gruppen-Compliance zu identifizieren. Unterstützung bei regelmäßigen risikobasierten Design- und Betriebseffektivitätstests von First-Line-AML/CFT-Kontrollen, einschließlich bei Kunden mit geringerem Risiko. -Repräsentieren Sie bei Bedarf Compliance bei Projekten und Initiativen im Zusammenhang mit Finanzkriminalität. Unterstützung bei der Lösung von Compliance-eigenen Management-Aktionsplänen aus Audits, Inspektionen und Gruppenbewertungen. Erstellung relevanter Management-Informationsberichte an Vorstand und Geschäftsleitung zur Steuerung von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken. Aufbau und Pflege einer proaktiven und konstruktiven Beziehung zu Unternehmen und funktionalen Stakeholdern, um sicherzustellen, dass angemessene Kontrollen für die Identifizierung und das Management von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken vorhanden sind. -Halten Sie sich auf dem Laufenden und verstehen Sie die Auswirkungen neuer Vorschriften für Finanzkriminalität und vertreten Sie die Bank bei Bedarf in Branchenberatungen. Vertrautheit mit Vorschriften und Leitlinien in einer AML, Financial Crime Compliance Rolle. -6-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Einhaltung von AML/CFT, insbesondere bei Untersuchungen. -Vorherige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Privatbank wird von Vorteil sein. -Hochwirksame verbale und schriftliche Kommunikation und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. La tua squadra Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone. FundPartner Solutions offre una suite completa di servizi di gestione fondi e private label. Il team globale di esperti del settore si specializza nella domiciliazione dei fondi, registrazione e governance, così come nel rispetto dei rischi e nei servizi di gestione degli investimenti. Le operazioni forniscono un trattamento sicuro ed efficiente delle transazioni bancarie e dei fondi di investimento di Pictet. I nostri team assicurano che tutte le attività seguano le normative e gestiscano i rischi. Sviluppando e mantenendo un'infrastruttura moderna e robusta, garantiamo servizi affidabili e di alta qualità per la gestione della ricchezza Pictet, la gestione degli asset e i clienti immobiliari. Questo ruolo sosterrà il Dashboard Team di FundPartner Solutions , focalizzandosi sullo sviluppo e l'implementazione di progetti di dashboard relativi alla raccolta fondi. La posizione prevede una stretta collaborazione con i team di operazioni di fondo per identificare, definire e fornire soluzioni di visualizzazione e reporting dati efficaci. Le responsabilità principali includono la progettazione, il test e la distribuzione di dashboard e visualizzazioni dei dati, principalmente utilizzando Tableau, nonché la gestione di database correlati. Il tuo ruolo

• Provata esperienza nello sviluppo di dashboard e visualizzazioni con Tableau, compresa l'integrazione di script personalizzati (Python, SAS, ecc.).
• Competenza nella pulizia, gestione e analisi dei dati.
• Interesse a metodi innovativi per raccogliere, analizzare, presentare e diffondere informazioni.
• Capacità avanzata negli strumenti di MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Morbide competenze:
• Forte capacità di problem solving e esperienza nella gestione del progetto.
• Eccellente capacità organizzative, rigore e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Versatilità, proattività e capacità di gestire più attività contemporaneamente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. This role will support the Dashboard Team at FundPartner Solutions , focusing on the development and implementation of dashboard projects related to fund reporting. The position involves close collaboration with fund operations teams to identify, define, and deliver effective data visualization and reporting solutions. Core responsibilities include designing, testing, and deploying dashboards and data visualizations, primarily using Tableau, as well as managing related databases. Your role
• Identify and analyze reporting and operational monitoring needs in collaboration with business teams.
• Define the necessary data structures in partnership with data teams.
• Design, adapt, and publish dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Tableau.
• Ensure quality control through data checks, testing, and regular feedback on new dashboard features. Your profile Education:
• Master’s degree in a technical discipline (digital transformation, information management, statistics, or equivalent). Requested experience:
• Experience in the investment fund sector is preferred. Technical skills:
• Proven experience in developing dashboards and visualizations with Tableau, including integration of custom scripts (Python, SAS, etc.).
• Proficiency in data cleaning, management, and analysis.
• Interest in innovative methods for collecting, analyzing, presenting, and disseminating information.
• Advanced proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Soft skills:
• Strong problem-solving skills and experience in project management.
• Excellent organizational skills, rigor, and attention to detail.
• Versatility, proactivity, and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Team spirit, professionalism, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Language skills:
• Fluency in spoken and written English; French is an advantage. Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) è uno specialista di investimento alternativo leader e interamente controllata del Gruppo Pictet, con competenze in fondi di copertura, private equity e immobili globali. Con i team di tutto il mondo, i team PAA costruiscono, gestiscono e consigliano portafogli di soluzioni di investimento alternative per clienti istituzionali e privati. Sarete parte di un team di 20 professionisti dedicati al franchise paneuropeo Direct Real Estate di Pictet, iniziato nel 2019 con il lancio di Elevation Fund I, un fondo di valore di 700 milioni di euro. Elevation Fund II è stato lanciato nel 2023, e un fondo Core Plus, con circa 200 milioni di euro sotto la gestione, è stato lanciato nel 2021. Il team è distribuito in diverse sedi: a Londra, dove si basano i principali team di investimento e asset management; a Ginevra, dove operano i team di investimento legali e di relazioni con gli investitori; e a Berlino, Stoccolma e Madrid, dove si trovano i nostri capi regionali. Inoltre, le funzioni di sostegno dei fondi come l'amministrazione dei fondi, la conformità e le questioni legali sono situate in Lussemburgo. Con sede a Ginevra o a Londra, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il Senior Legal Advisor che copre l'attività di Direct Real Estate per sostenere l'attività durante il congedo di maternità del nostro Legal Advisor. Il tuo ruolo
• Guidare la revisione, la redazione e la negoziazione di una vasta gamma di documenti immobiliari e finanziari, compresi gli accordi degli azionisti, accordi di finanziamento, accordi di locazione, SPA, accordi di costruzione, ecc.
• Sostenere le transazioni immobiliari dirette dall'inizio alla chiusura, contribuendo a guidare l'esecuzione coordinando i flussi di lavoro legali, gestendo i negoziati e liaising con gli stakeholder interni e i consulenti esterni.
• Agire come partner legale chiave in materia transfrontaliera, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team interni di tutte le giurisdizioni sullo stato delle transazioni, la documentazione, la meccanica dei pagamenti e le relative fasi di esecuzione. Sarebbe importante dimostrare di aver condotto transazioni in almeno 3 diverse giurisdizioni.
• Fornire assistenza legale quotidiana in materia di asset management e di progetto, combinando una forte stesura legale tecnica con un approccio pratico e orientato alle soluzioni alle questioni aziendali. La mentalità orientata agli affari trova soluzioni ai problemi del nostro team invece di agire solo come portiere.
• Guidare e sostenere la documentazione legale per le questioni di sviluppo, costruzione e ristrutturazione, tra cui la preparazione, la revisione e la finalizzazione dei progetti e dei contratti di lavoro per le controparti. Il tuo profilo
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza (post-qualifica) nel reparto immobiliare di uno studio legale importante e rispettabile.
• Rigoroso, con ottime capacità di numerazione e un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Un forte interesse per e/o esperienza con l'AI sarebbe un bene.
• La fluenza in inglese è un must, francese, spagnolo, tedesco o danese sarebbe un bene.
• Il ruolo può essere situato a Londra o a Ginevra. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro. Applicare Salva lavoro Email a un contatto Torna alla lista
