La tua squadra

A Pictet, le nostre divisioni Technology and Operations lavorano in stretta collaborazione per fornire soluzioni innovative, sicure ed efficienti che spingono il successo del Gruppo. La divisione Technology sviluppa e integra soluzioni software avanzate, come sistemi di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di trading e applicazioni bancarie, giocando un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione del valore del cliente. La divisione Operazioni garantisce il trattamento sicuro ed efficiente delle transazioni bancarie e dei fondi di investimento, mantenendo la conformità normativa e la gestione dei rischi operativi per supportare l'affidabilità dei nostri servizi finanziari.

Insieme, la tecnologia e le operazioni costituiscono la spina dorsale della capacità di Pictet di offrire esperienze client eccezionali, svolgendo un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione di valore.

Sarai parte del team Finance Pictet Tech & Operations. Il team svolge un ruolo fondamentale nello sterzo finanziario della divisione, fornendo dati finanziari tempestivi e rilevanti e report nell'allineamento delle strategie finanziarie con gli obiettivi aziendali e fornendo informazioni attuabili agli stakeholder.

Il tuo ruolo

Come membro del team Finance Tech & Operations, possiederai lo sviluppo di dashboard finanziari, gestirai modelli di dati analitici finanziari, automatizza i processi di produzione di report e agirai come principale collegamento di finanza con il team Central Data Engineering. Contribuirai sia alla continuità operativa dei processi finanziari sia alla trasformazione a più lungo termine dell'analisi delle finanze all'interno della Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Assicurare la coerenza e l'integrità dei dati attraverso gli strati di reporting di finanza e le pipeline di dati a monte.
• Sviluppare e gestire il modello di dati analitici finanziari, assicurando che riflette con precisione le ultime opinioni analitiche.
• Guidare l'automazione dei processi di produzione e reporting dei dati finanziari, eliminando i flussi di lavoro manuali e migliorando l'affidabilità e la frequenza dei report finanziari.
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di cruscotti finanziari che coprono P&L per prodotto, allocazione dei costi e KPI operativi allineati con nuovo modello operativo.
• Supporto FP&A e attività di gestione contabile con analisi robuste e scalabili.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in informatica, scienza dei dati, ingegneria o un campo correlato.
• 3-5 anni di esperienza come analista di dati – esperienza di collaborazione con i team finanziari è un vantaggio.
• Forte competenza in SQL, pitone e esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collegare gli stakeholder tecnici (Data Engineering) e aziendali (Finance).
• Automotivato, proattivo e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente.
• Volontà di imparare e adattarsi a nuove tecnologie e strumenti.
• Residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi.

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie.

Ref.: FDA/CC/ FAA

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

At Pictet, our Technology and Operations divisions work in close partnership to deliver innovative, secure, and efficient solutions that drive the Group’s success. The Technology division develops and integrates advanced software solutions, such as portfolio management systems, trading platforms, and banking applications – playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and client value creation. The Operations division ensures the secure and efficient processing of banking transactions and investment funds, maintaining regulatory compliance and managing operational risks to support the reliability of our financial services.

Together, Technology and Operations form the backbone of Pictet’s ability to deliver outstanding client experiences, playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and value creation.

You will be part of the Finance Pictet Tech & Operations team. The team plays a pivotal role in the financial steering of the division, by providing timely, relevant financial data and reports in aligning financial strategies with business objectives and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.

Your role

As a member of the Finance Tech & Operations team, you will own the development of financial dashboards, manage finance analytical data models, automate reporting production processes, and act as the primary Finance liaison with the Central Data Engineering team. You will contribute to both the operational continuity of financial processes and the longer-term transformation of Finance analytics within Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Ensure data consistency and integrity across finance reporting layers and upstream data pipelines.
• Develop and manage the finance analytical data model, ensuring it accurately reflects latest analytical views.
• Drive the automation of finance data production and reporting processes, eliminating manual workflows and enhancing the reliability and frequency of financial reporting.
• Design, build, and maintain financial dashboards covering P&L by product, cost allocation, and operational KPIs aligned with new operating model.
• Support FP&A and management accounting activities with robust, scalable analytics.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience as a data analyst – experience collaborating with finance teams is a plus.
• Strong proficiency in SQL, python, and experience with visualisation tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical (Data Engineering) and business (Finance) stakeholders.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : FDA/CC/FAA

Ihr Team

Unsere Divisionen Technologie und Operations arbeiten bei Pictet in enger Partnerschaft, um innovative, sichere und effiziente Lösungen zu schaffen, die den Erfolg des Konzerns vorantreiben. Der Bereich Technologie entwickelt und integriert fortschrittliche Softwarelösungen, wie Portfoliomanagement-Systeme, Handelsplattformen und Banking-Anwendungen – eine Schlüsselrolle in der digitalen Transformation und der Wertschöpfung der Gruppe. Der Geschäftsbereich Operationen gewährleistet die sichere und effiziente Abwicklung von Bankgeschäften und Investmentfonds, die Einhaltung regulatorischer Compliance und das Management operativer Risiken zur Unterstützung der Zuverlässigkeit unserer Finanzdienstleistungen.

Gemeinsam bilden Technologie und Operationen das Rückgrat von Pictets Fähigkeit, herausragende Kundenerfahrungen zu liefern, eine Schlüsselrolle in der digitalen Transformation und Wertschöpfung der Gruppe zu spielen.

Sie werden Teil des Finance Pictet Tech & Operations Teams sein. Das Team spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Finanzlenkung der Division, indem es zeitnahe, relevante Finanzdaten und Berichte zur Ausrichtung von Finanzstrategien mit Geschäftszielen und zur Bereitstellung von handlungsfähigen Erkenntnissen an Interessenvertreter gibt.

Ihre Rolle

Als Mitglied des Finance Tech & Operations Teams besitzen Sie die Entwicklung von Finanz-Dashboards, verwalten Finanzanalysedatenmodelle, automatisieren Reporting-Produktionsprozesse und fungieren als primäre Finanz-Verbindung mit dem Central Data Engineering Team. Sie werden sowohl zur operativen Kontinuität von Finanzprozessen als auch zur langfristigen Transformation von Finanzanalysen in Pictet Technology und Operations beitragen.

• Gewährleistung der Datenkonsistenz und -integrität über Finanzberichte und vorgelagerte Datenpipelines.
• Entwicklung und Verwaltung des Finanzanalytischen Datenmodells, um sicherzustellen, dass es die neuesten analytischen Ansichten genau widerspiegelt.
• Die Automatisierung von Finanzdatenproduktions- und Berichtsprozessen, die Beseitigung manueller Workflows und die Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit und Häufigkeit der Finanzberichterstattung.
• Konzipieren, bauen und pflegen finanzielle Dashboards, die P&L nach Produkt, Kostenzuweisung und operativen Kennzahlen abdecken, die mit dem neuen Betriebsmodell übereinstimmen.
• Unterstützung von FP&A- und Management-Buchungsaktivitäten mit robusten, skalierbaren Analysen.

Ihr Profil

• Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Datenwissenschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung als Data Analyst – Erfahrung in Zusammenarbeit mit Finanzteams ist ein Plus.
• Starke Kenntnisse in SQL, Python und Erfahrung mit Visualisierungstools.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten, mit viel Liebe zum Detail.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, technische (Data Engineering) und Business (Finance) Stakeholder zu überbrücken.
• Selbstmotiviert, proaktiv und selbständig arbeiten können.
• Bereitschaft, neue Technologien und Werkzeuge zu lernen und anzupassen.
• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bereit, sich zu verlagern.

La division Technologie développe et intègre des solutions logicielles avancées, telles que les systèmes de gestion de portefeuille, les plateformes de négociation et les applications bancaires – jouant un rôle clé dans la transformation numérique du Groupe et la création de valeur client. La Division des opérations assure le traitement sûr et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement, en maintenant la conformité réglementaire et en gérant les risques opérationnels pour soutenir la fiabilité de nos services financiers. Ensemble, la technologie et les opérations constituent l'épine dorsale de la capacité de Pictet à offrir des expériences clients exceptionnelles, jouant un rôle clé dans la transformation numérique du Groupe et la création de valeur. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe Finance Pictet Tech & Operations. L'équipe joue un rôle central dans la direction financière de la division, en fournissant en temps opportun des données et des rapports financiers pertinents afin d'aligner les stratégies financières sur les objectifs opérationnels et de fournir des renseignements concrets aux intervenants. Votre rôle En tant que membre de l'équipe Finance Tech & Operations, vous serez propriétaire du développement de tableaux de bord financiers, gérerez les modèles de données analytiques financières, automatiserez les processus de production de rapports et agirez comme principale liaison financière avec l'équipe Central Data Engineering. Vous contribuerez à la continuité opérationnelle des processus financiers et à la transformation à long terme de l'analyse des finances au sein de Pictet Technology and Operations. • Assurer la cohérence et l'intégrité des données entre les niveaux de déclaration des finances et les pipelines de données en amont. • Élaborer et gérer le modèle de données d'analyse financière, en veillant à ce qu'il reflète fidèlement les dernières opinions analytiques. • Diriger l'automatisation des processus de production et d'établissement de rapports financiers, éliminer les flux de travail manuels et améliorer la fiabilité et la fréquence des rapports financiers. • Concevoir, construire et entretenir des tableaux de bord financiers couvrant les P&L par produit, la répartition des coûts et les ICR opérationnels alignés sur le nouveau modèle opérationnel. • Soutenir les activités de comptabilité et d'évaluation et de gestion avec des analyses robustes et évolutives. Votre profil • Maîtrise en informatique, informatique, ingénierie ou domaine connexe. • 3-5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'analyste de données – l'expérience de collaboration avec les équipes financières est un atout. • Forte compétence en SQL, python et expérience avec les outils de visualisation. • Excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une attention particulière aux détails. • De solides compétences en communication, avec la capacité de relier les acteurs techniques (ingénierie des données) et commerciaux (Finances). • Automotivé, proactif et capable de travailler indépendamment. • La volonté d'apprendre et de s'adapter aux nouvelles technologies et outils. • Résident en Suisse ou désireux de déménager. Remarque Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire des agences. Réf. : FDA/CC/FAA Diversité et inclusion Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons toutes les personnes et nous cherchons à les inclure dans le milieu de travail. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience. The role of the function is to ensure the smooth running of the publishing production according to the SLAs, deadlines and roadmaps in place for in-house and third-party funds. A high level of client support (internal and external) will be expected. Your role
• Code request as part of fund launch process (LEI, Bloomberg Tickers, etc…).
• Set up, control / update of static and dynamic data.
• Contribute to the efficient and accurate execution of publishing operations.
• Activate and publish request according to registration status.
• Disseminate legal fund documentations, monthly portfolio reports and No NAV calculation reports.
• Manage the chargeback of invoices.
• Collect and organize documents.
• Scan and archive documents and data. Your profile Knowledge /Technical skills:
• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related
• 2-year experience in banking sector
• Good knowledge in fund operations, process and data analysis
• In-depth knowledge of MS Office and banking softwares (Multifonds, Luxis and Avaloq)
• Excellent knowledge of operational banking and legal perspective for funds
• Good knowledge in Python programming and being at ease with the use of AI Tools would be considered as distinguishing factors. Soft skills:
• Rigor
• Attention to detail
• Organizational skills
• Team spirit
• Problem solving abilities Language skills
• Fluent in french and english Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

Pictet is seeking to recruit a Marketing Manager (1-Year Contract) to work in the Marketing Asia - HKG team to support and coordinate marketing activities for Pictet Asset Management in Asia excluding Japan, contributing to brand visibility and business development in the region.

• Coordinate and execute regional marketing strategies and campaigns, including advertising, events, web, social media, and other marketing initiatives.

• Assist in the development and production of marketing collaterals, from information and data collection through to distribution, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.

• Monitor the publication of global marketing content and support local content production and translation, liaising with external service providers as needed.

• Demonstrate creativity in developing innovative marketing campaigns and designing thoughtful client gifts that are highly valued and appreciated by recipients.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, including local business teams, compliance, and headquarter marketing counterparts, to deliver marketing activities.

• Help maintain and update the firm’s web, digital, and social media platforms, ensuring content is accurate and engaging.

• Manage relationships with external vendors for the production of marketing assets, campaigns, events, and other communications materials.

• Track and report on marketing performance using analytics and KPIs, providing insights for ongoing improvement.

Your profile

• University graduate in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant discipline.

• 5-10 years of solid marketing and communications experience in financial institutions is highly preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and creativity.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and desktop publishing tools.

• Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Chinese.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.

• A proactive, results-oriented team player with a passion for marketing.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Votre équipe Pictet Asset Services (PAS) propose des services de banque dépositaire, des services liés aux fonds ainsi que des solutions de trading à des gérants indépendants, à des gestionnaires de fonds et à des clients institutionnels. Nous maîtrisons en interne chaque dimension de l’asset servicing et concevons des solutions sur mesure, telles que des outils analytiques à valeur ajoutée, des supports à l’élaboration de stratégies de trading et des interfaces utilisateurs, pour offrir une expérience client inégalée. Votre rôle - Etre le contact principal pour un portefeuille de gérants indépendants (GI). - Offrir un support et résoudre les problèmes pour toutes les thématiques opérationnelles et administratives. - Participer au processus administratif de mise en place des relations GI et de leurs comptes clients, en collaboration avec les chargés de relations (CRM). - Traiter les opérations de paiement et de transfert, en veillant à ce que les appels de vérification (call-back) soient effectués de manière systématique, et fournir un soutien pour les autres types de transactions, selon les besoins. - Traiter les demandes (codifications clients internes, cartes de crédit, limites de crédit, conditions spéciales, etc.) et effectuer les saisies dans les workflows correspondants. - Gérer le flux documentaire (archivage, traitement des formulaires physiques et électroniques). - Bien connaître les principaux partenaires internes, établir avec eux d’étroites relations et être leur interlocuteur/trice de référence pour le portefeuille. - Veiller à ce que la prise des appels téléphoniques soit assurée au sein de l’équipe et fournir un soutien pour les tâches administratives. - Appliquer les politiques et directives en vigueur et accompagner la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règles. Votre profil - Formation bancaire ou jugée équivalente. - Expérience de 5 ans dans le support aux GI. - Excellentes connaissances transversales au niveau des flux opérationnels. - Sens du service à la clientèle. - Solide esprit d’équipe. - Aptitude à communiquer avec une grande aisance. - Sens développé des responsabilités, résistance au stress et capacité à gérer des situations délicates. - Sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités. - Très bonne connaissance des outils informatiques usuels MS Office/Avaloq. - Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral. - Domicile en Suisse requis. Note CRO/FH/AA We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Votre rôle - Etre le contact principal pour un portefeuille de gérants indépendants (GI). - Offrir un support et résoudre les problèmes pour toutes les thématiques opérationnelles et administratives. - Participer au processus administratif de mise en place des relations GI et de leurs comptes clients, en collaboration avec les chargés de relations (CRM). - Traiter les opérations de paiement et de transfert, en veillant à ce que les appels de vérification (call-back) soient effectués de manière systématique, et fournir un soutien pour les autres types de transactions, selon les besoins. - Traiter les demandes (codifications clients internes, cartes de crédit, limites de crédit, conditions spéciales, etc.) et effectuer les saisies dans les workflows correspondants. - Gérer le flux documentaire (archivage, traitement des formulaires physiques et électroniques). - Bien connaître les principaux partenaires internes, établir avec eux d’étroites relations et être leur interlocuteur/trice de référence pour le portefeuille. - Veiller à ce que la prise des appels téléphoniques soit assurée au sein de l’équipe et fournir un soutien pour les tâches administratives. - Appliquer les politiques et directives en vigueur et accompagner la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règles. Votre profil - Formation bancaire ou jugée équivalente. - Expérience de 5 ans dans le support aux GI. - Excellentes connaissances transversales au niveau des flux opérationnels. - Sens du service à la clientèle. - Solide esprit d’équipe. - Aptitude à communiquer avec une grande aisance. - Sens développé des responsabilités, résistance au stress et capacité à gérer des situations délicates. - Sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités. - Très bonne connaissance des outils informatiques usuels MS Office/Avaloq. - Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral. - Domicile en Suisse requis. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. The Group has strong growth ambitions for PAA for the years ahead, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base. Based in Geneva, you will become part of a dynamic five-person team on a six-month temporary contract, assisting with a rise in workload and activity. Your role will involve offering operational support for both hedge fund portfolios and managed accounts. Your role
• Managing and coordinating operations linked to PAA’s hedge fund products and mandates (NAV calculations, reporting, transactions and client services).
• Providing support to the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations). Your profile
• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of hedge fund operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Use of Webfolio is a plus.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Your team The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. Pictet has been present in Singapore for over 30 years, supported by a team exceeding 200 employees. Your role
• Client Management o Prepare relevant files and account reports for relevant parties prior to meeting with clients. o Respond to client queries and attend to issues and requests. o Assist with the administrative support of clients’ relationships, and liaise with all other Departments when required (operational, administration, investment, legal etc.). o Ensure client's records / accounts / investments / market information are current and information updates are timely maintained with relevant accompanying correspondences and meeting reports.
• Business Development o Keep the CEO advised of time-sensitive and high-priority issues, ensuring appropriate follow up. o Liaise with head office for any administrative issues. o Assist in composing replies for CEO’s review and approval as and when required. o Ensure fit-and-proper requirements are met (e.g. CPD requirements, complete mandatory training etc.) as stipulated by the regulators.
• Provide strong coordination support across respective Investment Teams within the Bank
• Liaison for Stakeholder teams o Interface for Risk, Marketing, Compliance, Business Heads, Management Teams, etc both internal and external stakeholders o Serve as a liaison between CEO, Management Team, internal and external stakeholders.
• Operational Support o Ensure necessary follow-up actions are promptly taken on various operational matters e.g. deficiency and outstanding documentation. o Provide efficient day-to-day support (including email inbox management, co-ordination, and other ad hoc tasks). o Maintain the CEO’s calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, business travel arrangements. o Schedule and organize departmental meetings; assist in the preparation and distribution of meeting agendas and materials. Your profile
• University degree or equivalent, preferably in Business Management, Economics or Finance.
• Strong understanding of local and regional regulatory climate
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with the highest professional work ethic and standards.
• Exercises discretion and maintains confidentiality and sensitivity of matters.
• Strong sense of initiative and resourcefulness to resolve issues as responsibilities and challenges vary.
• Excellent interpersonal, communication and client interfacing skills.
• Strong understanding of financial products and services.
• First class presentation and communication skills
• Familiar with AML and compliance requirements within the Private Banking space. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Monitor orders for UCI share subscriptions/redemptions, transfers and conversions.

• Prepare and send out confirmations and reports to promoters, distributors and other fund intermediaries.

• Respond rapidly to different requests from clients (inside and outside the Group) to guarantee that a quality service is provided that meets the requirements of a demanding client.

• Manage client commissions and dividends for in-house and third-party funds.

• Manage events on Funds (in kind transfers, launches, liquidations…).

• Work on automating various configurations within the tool “Multifonds Global Investor”, primarily focusing on Fund setup, by implementing key controls.

• Play a coordinating role in fund-related events across teams, including fund launches, compartments, classes, mergers, and liquidations.

• Review Fund’s prospectuses to ensure alignment between promoter requests and system feasibility.

• Offer technical and functional support to other teams within the service.

Your profile

• Extensive knowledge of the Transfer Agent business and all-round understanding of fund administration processes

• Unversity degree in Economics or Finance

• 5 years' experience in similar position

• Fluent in french and english

• Excellent knowledge of the “MFGI - Multifonds Global Investor” tool and proven experience in its usage.

• Extensive knowledge of the Office suite.

• SQL knowledge is a must have.

• Flexibility

• Ability to handle stress.

• Rigor in checking, sending, confirming and monitoring orders.

• Enthusiasm and drive and ability to show initiative in solving problems.

• Enquiring mind and ability to learn quickly.

• Team player.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. Start date: ASAP Duration: 12 months Employment rate: Full-time or Part-time (80% - 1 school day per week) Prerequisite : a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school Your role
• Actively participate in client data remediation plan within the bank’s secure environment, specifically in the client repository.
• Understand account lifecycle processes and perform codifications in accordance with established procedures.
• Work closely with team members and key stakeholders such as Front Office, Compliance, and Legal departments.
• Contribute to the update and improvement of internal procedures.
• Take part in various projects and initiatives aimed at optimizing client data management and supporting the continuous improvement of operational processes. Your profile
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.
• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.
• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
• Proficient in standard MS Office products.
• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.
• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism.
• Fluent in written and spoken French; good command of English. German is an asset. Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. descriptionByLocale.it:
Votre équipe FundPartner Solutions propose une gamme complète de services d’administration de fonds et de création de fonds sur mesure. Ses équipes de spécialistes apportent leurs compétences en matière de domiciliation, d’enregistrement et de gouvernance de fonds, ainsi que de gestion des risques et de contrôle du respect des directives de placement. En tant que Business Compliance & Operations Liaison Officer vous serez responsable de la gestion et de la coordination des projets entre les diverses équipes de la société ainsi qu’avec les prestataires externes de type gestionnaires de fortune collective. Vous assurerez un support opérationnel de qualité, coordonnerez les flux d’information et veillerez à la conformité des processus liés à l’administration et à la gouvernance des fonds d’investissement de droit suisse. Ce rôle est essentiel pour garantir une efficience optimale et le respect des exigences réglementaires lors de la mise en place et du suivi de fonds d’investissements. Votre rôle
• Agir comme point de contact principal pour les équipes internes (juridique, compliance, risques, administration fonds) sur les aspects opérationnels et administratifs.
• Gérer la coordination légale et opérationnelle des projets liés à la mise en place de nouveaux fonds ou mandats de gestion, en collaboration avec les départements internes et externes (gérants, autorité, audit, etc).
• Coordonner et suivre les projets clients, en veillant à la collecte des documents, au respect des délais et à la bonne communication entre les parties prenantes pour assurer leur mise en œuvre.
• Assurer la mise à jour, la gestion et la publication des données des fonds de placement dans les systèmes internes, ainsi que la production de rapports réglementaires et opérationnels.
• Gérer la coordination et la préparation administrative des demandes provenant de diverses autorités (FINMA, AFC, etc) ainsi que des demandes d’audit interne et externe participer aux activités et tâches liées à la gouvernance d’entreprise.
• Soutenir opérationnellement les équipes dans le suivi et l’implémentation des documents et des contrats de la société et participer au processus clé de vérification nécessaires pour les divers processus de la société.
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus, à l’optimisation des outils de travail et à la préparation de documents pour les clients et comités internes. Votre profil
• Solide expérience (5-10 ans) dans le secteur bancaire ou financier, avec formation supérieure (Bachelor ou équivalent).
• Bonne connaissance des produits financiers et des processus opérationnels en environnement financier.
• Maîtrise des réglementations suisses et internationales, avec curiosité et capacité à en comprendre les enjeux.
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (l’allemand est un atout), avec de bonnes compétences en communication.
• Maîtrise des outils MS Office et sens de l’organisation pour gérer plusieurs tâches en parallèle.
• Esprit d’équipe, orientation client, rigueur, autonomie et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
• Domicile en Suisse requis. Note BCLO/FH/IM We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience. As an intern within the Pictet Asset Services department, you will support the Client Relationship Management (CRO/CRM) teams in their daily activities. This internship will allow you to develop operational, regulatory, and interpersonal skills while contributing to the quality of client service.
• Start date: August/September
• Duration: 12 months
• Employment rate: part-time
• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school Your role
• Provide daily operational support to the teams in managing client files: preparation, verification, and follow-up of documents required for account opening, modification, or closure.
• Assist in the management of routine operations: signature verification, execution and monitoring of transactions (orders, payments, fund and asset transfers), management of incoming/outgoing flows, coordination with counterparties, and alerting in case of blockages.
• Participate in the preparation and updating of client files, ensuring information compliance and completeness of supporting documents.
• Support the teams in handling client requests, processing queries, and resolving simple incidents, ensuring rigorous follow-up and effective communication.
• Contribute to verifying the accuracy of transactions and the quality of data entered into internal tools.
• Act as a point of contact for administrative and logistical tasks related to client relationship management. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration or Economics.
• First experience (internship) in a client relationship management role within the financial services industry, idealy in private banking or wealth management Personal qualities:
• Attention to detail and organizational skills
• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach Language Skills:
• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken) Note Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 27 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5300 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1990, and employs approximately 400 people. Pictet Asset Management (PAM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. The PAM London HR team includes Generalist, Learning & Development and Reward & Benefits specialisms. Together, we partner with the business to provide comprehensive and high-touch support to approximately 300 PAM employees as well as delivering local HR support to colleagues in Pictet Wealth Management and Pictet Alternative Advisors. Your role Reporting to the Senior HR Business Partner, you will act as a trusted partner to defined client groups across PAM‘s enabling functions where you will be responsible for leading on all people related topics. This includes: › Recruitment: Collaborate with managers to understand hiring rationale, shape & execute the recruitment strategy including influencing job descriptions, sourcing strategy and interview structure as well as sharing insightful interview feedback. Support the hiring decision process and design offers with input from the Reward team. › Compensation & Benefits: Support managers through a seamless annual compensation review cycle, sharing input on salary reviews and bonus decisions. Act as the first point of contact for benefits related questions, calling on the guidance of the Reward team where needed. › Performance Management: Work closely with managers to ensure effective performance management practises are in place including objective setting, mid-years, and appraisals whilst fostering a culture of ongoing feedback. › Employee Relations: Serve as a trusted advisor on employee relations matters providing guidance on performance management practises, conflict resolution and disciplinary actions for example. › Talent Management: Guide managers through succession planning and talent mapping, supporting client groups to build a strong, skills focused talent pipeline. Support employees in their own development which may include advising on internal mobility, secondment opportunities etc. › Organisational Design & Employee Engagement : Provide advice on organisational design & structure and champion employee engagement initiatives to foster a culture of high performance and engagement. › Ensure all operational & life-cycle processes for dedicated client area run smoothly and effectively. For example, responsible for executing new joiner onboarding, amendments, leavers processes etc. › Support the broader Generalist HR team on regulatory change, process improvements, and policy updates. Your profile › At least five years’ HR experience in a fast-paced high-performance environment delivering the best possible outcomes for the business. › Sound knowledge of UK employment laws, employee relations, and regulations and the ability to apply them in live business scenarios. › Proven ability to manage stakeholders, influence, and navigate multiple priorities. › Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships across the business. › Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to manage complex and sensitive employee relations matters. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. HRBP/RF/CB Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 27 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5300 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1990, and employs approximately 400 people. Pictet Asset Management (PAM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. The PAM London HR team includes Generalist, Learning & Development and Reward & Benefits specialisms. Together, we partner with the business to provide comprehensive and high-touch support to approximately 300 PAM employees as well as delivering local HR support to colleagues in Pictet Wealth Management and Pictet Alternative Advisors. Your role Reporting to the Senior HR BP and working alongside two other HR generalists, you will become a trusted first point of contact and advisor to all colleagues in London across a range of HR generalist topics. › Recruitment : In collaboration with HR BPs, execute the recruit-ment strategy including drafting job descriptions, manage external recruitment support, organise interviews and issue contracts. In time, lead recruitment processes end to end with an initial focus on temporary roles. › Onboarding : Accompany new joiners from the point of signature to their first day in a seamless onboarding journey using SuccessFactors modules. Ownership of content & delivery of new joiner inductions, benefits briefings etc. Key liaison with IT, Compliance etc to ensure new joiner’s have full set-up from day one. › Benefits : Act as the first point of contact for benefits related questions, calling on the guidance of the Reward team where needed. › Ensure all operational & life-cycle processes run smoothly and effectively. For example, amendment letters, departure processes, background screenings, reference requests etc. › Employee Relations : Support HR BPs where needed or when a learning opportunity is available. For example, note taking during disciplinary, grievances or sickness absence processes. › Support the broader Generalist HR team on regulatory change, process improvements, and policy updates. Your profile › Approximately 1 years’ experience in a fast-paced high-performance environment delivering the best possible outcomes for the business. This could be within a HR, Recruitment, or Team Assistant role. › Experience using SuccessFactors, Icertis, and Docusign alongside an automation mindset are advantageous. › Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships across the business. › Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. HRO/RF/CB Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations. You’ll be part of the Cloud Engineering unit. In this unit, we are responsible of streamlining the development experience of product teams by delivering reliable and user-centric platforms covering observability, identity, continuous integration and delivery, release management and cloud capabilities. You will be embedded within the Release Management Team and will help building and maintaining the tooling used to manage and govern the release management at Pictet Tech . Your role
• Designing, building and operating a reliable platform providing release management capabilities to development teams.
• Contributing to the promotion of good practices in terms of Release Management within Pictet Group.
• Aligning with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and to provide guidance.
• Performing tasks expected of a platform engineer: development, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. Your profile
• You have experience in an engineering role (e.g., software engineer, devops, etc.).
• Proficiency in software craftsmanship practices and full stack development (i.e. Java, Spring, Typescript, Angular, Next.js).
• A well-established background in vibe coding paired with a strong passion for AI coding.
• Knowledge about architecture topics such as integration, security, network, identity and access management.
• Strong interest and knowledge of release management processes.
• As a plus, you have expertise in releasing core banking systems or such complex systems within a highly regulated environment.
• Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Deeply curious and eager to learn technologies and skills.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Swiss resident. Ref: DOE/CRO/XC Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. We are looking for a Private Assets Operations Specialist to join our Funds and Private Assets Services unit. Our department belongs to the Operations division, which provides a broad range of custodian and fund administration services. Based in Geneva, you will be joining a dynamic team that plays a central role in supporting the strategic growth of our Private Assets offering. Your role
• Execute subscriptions and transfer orders for Private Equity Funds and Private Placements.
• Book the transactions after confirmation.
• Operate the Organized Trading Facility of Interests.
• Resolve issues arising from reconciliations.
• Coordinate the reception of in-kind distributions.
• Prepare customized advice.
• Support and liaise with internal clients on a daily basis.
• Manage risks associated with Private Assets operations. Your profile
• University degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business and/or Economics, or the equivalent in work experience in the finance industry.
• Experience of 1 to 5 years in Private Assets Operations is a plus.
• Good user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems.
• Quick learning ability.
• Rigorous, team player and sense of responsibility.
• Solution-oriented and ability to manage complex cases.
• Fluent in French and English with excellent communication skills.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. Note PAOS / JLS / LS We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. title: Senior Manager - Strategic Planning & Financial Analysis

titleByLocale.it: Senior Manager - Pianificazione strategica e analisi finanziaria
titleByLocale.en: Senior Manager - Strategic Planning & Financial Analysis
titleByLocale.de: Senior Manager - Strategic Planning & Financial Analysis
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Manager - Strategic Planning & Financial Analysis

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation. We provide senior management with business and financial insights to enable them to define the strategic priorities of the Group and assist with the planning and monitoring of their implementation. Your role
• Lead a team of financial analysts.
• Manage capital planning for the Group’s main banking entities and at consolidated level, including the analysis and projections of risk-weighted assets.
• Oversee financial forecasting and scenario analysis for Group and business lines.
• Coordinate annual budgets, set targets and recommend resource allocations.
• Prepare business performance reviews, track budget attainment and monitor strategic initiatives.
• Facilitate long-term financial planning and evaluate the impact of proposed initiatives.
• Execute change projects and improve financial reporting tools and processes.
• Analyse market trends and conduct competitive benchmarking. Your profile
• Master’s degree or equivalent in STEM or Finance. MBA is a plus.
• 5-10 years’ experience in a similar role in a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team of a large organisation and a proven project management experience (Consultancy firm experience is a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and sense of ownership; comfortable with numbers and engaging senior stakeholders.
• Skilled presenter able to clearly convey financial insights to management.
• Knowledge of banking/asset management industries and experience with FP&A tools (Anaplan, Tagetik, SAP BPC) preferred.
• Fluent in English and French.
• Must reside in Switzerland or be open to relocation. As the chosen applicant you will be a self-starter, proactive and able to work on your own as well as being keen to join a young, dynamic and impactful team. You will be in contact with senior management across the Group, covering all of our business lines, and will be joining a Group that places emphasis on long-term thinking. You will also be expected to embrace the Group’s values and put these into practice in your daily activities. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. Ref. : SM-SP&FA/CC/CV Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre una gamma completa di servizi per individui e famiglie facoltose, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consulenziali, e servizi di family office. Mansioni - Servire come punto di ingresso per tutte le richieste operative da parte di banchieri o clienti. - Conducendo il processo di apertura del conto end-to-end, prendendo in considerazione le specificità normative locali che determinano i requisiti di documentazione. - Assicurare un rigoroso follow-up della documentazione (incluse le pendenze, l'ufficio centrale e le liste R&C) contattando i clienti, in coordinamento con il banchiere responsabile del rapporto. - Gestione dei flussi di documentazione (archiviazione e elaborazione di forme fisiche ed elettroniche). - Leading KYC information-gathering se necessario, e l'aggiornamento dei record supplementari nel sistema quando necessario. - Elaborazione delle richieste del flusso di lavoro nel sistema (codifiche dei clienti, richieste di carta di credito, linee di credito, eccezioni di prezzo, ecc.) e garantire la documentazione relativa del cliente è inserita nel sistema (memo, ordini, ecc.). - Coordinare a stretto contatto con Business Risk Manager della zona per risolvere qualsiasi problema di rischio e conformità. - Guidare e organizzare, all'interno del team, la priorità e la bonifica di eventuali Indicatori di rischio chiave contrassegnati. - Aderendo a tutte le politiche e direttive esistenti, e sostenere l'attuazione di nuove, se necessario. - Elaborazione dei pagamenti e dei trasferimenti, assicurando allo stesso tempo che i callback siano sistematicamente eseguiti e fornendo supporto ad altre attività transazionali, se necessario. - Promuovere stretti legami con le parti interessate interne pertinenti (Voyages, Middle Office, R&C, ecc.), imparare su ciò che fanno e agire come punto di contatto per la squadra. - Assicurare la copertura telefonica all'interno della squadra. - Sostenere i compiti amministrativi quando necessario.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive range of services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions, and family office services. As a Client Relationship Officer, you will be responsible for all operational aspects of daily banking activities. Your role will be to deliver a world-class client experience. Your role
• Serving as the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients.
• Leading the end-to-end account-opening process, taking the local regulatory specificities that determine documentation requirements into consideration.
• Ensuring a strict follow-up of documentation (including pendings, middle office andR&C lists) by contacting clients, in coordination with the banker in charge of the relationship.
• Managing documentation flows (archiving and processing physical and electronic forms).
• Leading KYC information-gathering where required, and updating supplementary records in the system when needed.
• Processing workflow requests in the system (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.) and ensuring relevant client documentation is entered into the system (memos, orders, etc.).
• Coordinating closely with the zone’s Business Risk Manager to resolve any risk and compliance matters.
• Leading and organising, within the team, the prioritisation and remediation of any Key Risk Indicators flagged.
• Adhering to all existing policies and directives, and support the implementation of new ones where needed.
• Processing payments and transfers, while ensuring callbacks are systematically performed, and providing support for other transactional activities where needed.
• Fostering close ties with the relevant internal stakeholders (Voyages, Middle Office, R&C, etc.), learning about what they do and acting as their point of contact for the team.
• Ensuring telephone call coverage within the team.
• Supporting administrative tasks where required. Your profile
• Bachelor's degree or similar.
• No less than 5 years’ experience in a similar role.
• Fluent in English, Spanish and Portugues; French is an advantage.
• Service orientated, with experience in dealing with private clients and supporting relationship managers.
• Firm grasp of wealth managers’ client documentation duties and related internal processes.
• Familiarity with regulatory dimensions (cross-border, R&C, PEP, CARA, FATCA, CRS etc.).
• Attention to detail.
• Able to work independently and diligently.
• Reliable and resilient, with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task.
• Solution-oriented and proactive mindset.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
• Strong team spirit. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1980, and employs near 400 people. Pictet Asset Management (PAM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. Your role As an Investment Risk Manager with an ESG tilt, working in close proximity with investment teams, you will provide support for the appropriate implementation and ongoing development of our sustainability and ESG related risk management framework. Whilst your primary focus will be on ESG-related risks management, you will also assist in the continued development of 2nd Line of Defence (L2) investment risk and regulatory risk activities. Reporting to the Head of ManCo Risk Management, you will assist in:
• Strengthening PAM’s ESG-related risk management oversight and control framework.
• Designing key risk and controls to identify, measure, and manage ESG-related risks associated with fund’s investment strategies.
• Assisting with the continued development and implementation of PAM’s ESG-related risk policy.
• Ensuring that regulatory risks and investment risks are identified and appropriately managed for PAM funds and investment mandates.
• Routinely monitoring portfolios, analysing investment risks and portfolio deviations.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to these activities are updated and maintained.
• Ensuring that issues identified are escalated in a timely manner.
• Contributing to risk reporting to the governing bodies (e.g. executive management, Board of Directors).
• Contributing to preparation of responses to regulators’ requests about risk-related topics. Your profile
• University degree or equivalent qualification.
• 3 to 5 years' prior experience in investment and regulatory risk management in the asset management industry with a sound understanding of ESG regulatory requirements, and ESG related risks. You will have acquired experience implementing ESG Risk Management frameworks and have practical experience of managing ESG-related risks.
• In-depth understanding of the asset management industry (portfolio management, trading, administration and fund distribution).
• Sound understanding of the regulatory environments in which PAM operations, including Switzerland, Luxembourg, and the UK.
• Skilled user of standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Coding experience is an asset (Python and/or other coding languages).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• As the successful applicant, you are motivated and passionate about sustainability topics. You will be proactive, disciplined and have a structured mindset; able to identify, analyse and solve issues.
• You will also have strong problem-solving skills coupled with an ability to develop creative approaches, models and systems. In addition, you will possess strong interpersonal skills, and be team orientated.
• CFA, CAIA or FRM would be an advantageous.
• Fluent in English. French and German would be an asset. This role can be based in either London or Geneva. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. Your role
• Lead and oversee all tax processes for investment funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
• Monitor changes in tax legislation and evaluate their impact on existing processes, implementing necessary updates as required.
• Act as a key liaison with tax authorities, auditors, clients, and legal advisors on tax matters and regulatory inquiries.
• Proactively challenge and enhance processes for calculating and controlling tax figures to deliver high-quality service to clients.
• Stay up to date with tax developments across various jurisdictions (tax watch) and actively build a professional network.
• Manage tax-related risks, ensuring effective incident tracking and timely reporting to management.
• Serve as the main point of contact for all tax-related inquiries regarding funds, supporting both internal stakeholders (CRM) and external clients.
• Participate in client meetings and presentations as the subject matter expert on tax. Your profile
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Economics, Finance or Engineering
• 7 years' experience in similar function
• Fluent in french and english
• Economic, financial and accounting knowledge
• Expertise in international tax environment
• Excellent skills in tax reporting and calculation for funds
• Comprehensive understanding of fund administration
• MFGA (Accounting system) knowledge
• Good knowledge of various financial instruments and their functioning
• Proficiency in IT tools, particularly Excel and SQL queries
• Client-focused with strong communication skills
• Demonstrates rigor, methodological approach, high stress tolerance, initiative, and a high degree of independence
• Priority management, self-organization
• Analytical mindset, problem-solving skills, ability to propose solutions
• Able to actively participate in operational projects Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive range of services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions, and family office services. As a Client Relationship Officer, you will be responsible for all operational aspects of daily banking activities. Your role will be to deliver a world-class client experience. Your role
• Serving as the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients.
• Leading the end-to-end account-opening process, taking the local regulatory specificities that determine documentation requirements into consideration.
• Ensuring a strict follow-up of documentation (including pendings, middle office andR&C lists) by contacting clients, in coordination with the banker in charge of the relationship.
• Managing documentation flows (archiving and processing physical and electronic forms).
• Leading KYC information-gathering where required, and updating supplementary records in the system when needed.
• Processing workflow requests in the system (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.) and ensuring relevant client documentation is entered into the system (memos, orders, etc.).
• Coordinating closely with the zone’s Business Risk Manager to resolve any risk and compliance matters.
• Leading and organising, within the team, the prioritisation and remediation of any Key Risk Indicators flagged.
• Adhering to all existing policies and directives, and support the implementation of new ones where needed.
• Processing payments and transfers, while ensuring callbacks are systematically performed, and providing support for other transactional activities where needed.
• Fostering close ties with the relevant internal stakeholders (Voyages, Middle Office, R&C, etc.), learning about what they do and acting as their point of contact for the team.
• Ensuring telephone call coverage within the team.
• Supporting administrative tasks where required. Your profile
• Bachelor's degree or similar.
• No less than 5 years’ experience in a similar role.
• Fluent in English and Spanish; French and Portuguese an advantage.
• Service orientated, with experience in dealing with private clients and supporting relationship managers.
• Firm grasp of wealth managers’ client documentation duties and related internal processes.
• Familiarity with regulatory dimensions (cross-border, R&C, PEP, CARA, FATCA, CRS etc.).
• Attention to detail.
• Able to work independently and diligently.
• Reliable and resilient, with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task.
• Solution-oriented and proactive mindset.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
• Strong team spirit. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Ref.:"FT/CRO/MB" Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. Your role You will reinforce the team by helping to ensure that all inherent risks associated with Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed, assist with the continued development and implementation of the Pictet AM ManCo Risk Management framework including the investment risk management framework, and by helping the Head of ManCo Risk to provide senior management with information about the risks facing the business and the effectiveness of mitigating actions. Your tasks will include :
• Assisting the Head of ManCo Risk in ensuring that investment risks are identified and appropriately managed.
• Ensuring that regulatory risks for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed.
• Independently reviewing and assessing potential investment breaches for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds.
• Overseeing delegated investment controlling activities and risk management capabilities of delegated portfolio managers.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to the activity are properly updated and maintained.
• Contributing to Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled fund events management (e.g. launches, mergers, etc.) from a risk perspective, and overseeing these events.
• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to the activity are properly updated and maintained.
• Contributing to risk reporting to the governing bodies (e.g. executive management, Board of Directors).
• Contributing to preparing responses to regulators’ requests about risk-related topics and to the oversight of counterparty risk . Your profile
• University degree (undergraduate or postgraduate), or a qualification deemed equivalent.
• CFA, CAIA or FRM would be an asset.
• Three to five years’ experience in a similar role (investment and regulatory risk management) in the asset management industry.
• In-depth understanding of the asset management industry (portfolio management, trading, administration and fund distribution).
• Experience in counterparty risk management.
• Good knowledge of Swiss requirements in terms of risk management and of Swiss regulations for asset management and funds (knowledge of the Luxembourg regulatory environment would be an asset).
• Sound financial knowledge.
• Fluent in French and English; German would be a plus.
• Skilled user of standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. title: Client Relationship Officer - Pictet North America - 8 months contract

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Relazioni con i Clienti - Pictet Nord America - contratto di 8 mesi
titleByLocale.en: Client Relationship Officer - Pictet North America - 8 months contract
titleByLocale.de: Client Relationship Officer - Pictet North America - 8 months contract
titleByLocale.fr: Client Relationship Officer - Pictet North America - 8 months contract

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet North America Advisors SA (PNAA) provides investment services to private clients. Founded in 2007, the SEC-registered company devises portfolio diversification strategies for clients based in the US and Canada. We are seeking to recruit a Client Relationship Officer for our US clients (UHNWI) on an 8 months contract. You will be working for PNAA in Geneva and will be the point of entry for all operational requests from relationship managers or clients. As most of our clients custody their assets with Banque Pictet & Cie SA, you will also work closely with its organization for outsourced custodian activities. Your role Your responsibilities will include the following:
• Assisting the CRM with daily client-related tasks (debit list, maturities, etc.).
• Processing payments and transfers while ensuring that call-backs are systematically performed, and assisting with other transactional activities when needed.
• Ensuring strict follow-up of documentation (pending items, Middle Office, Risk & Compliance lists) by contacting clients, together with the CRM responsible for the relationship.
• Managing documentation flows (archiving and processing physical and electronic forms).
• Processing workflow requests in the systems (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.) and ensuring that the relevant client documentation is captured in the systems (memos, orders, etc.).
• Working closely with the zone’s COO and CCO to resolve any Risk & Compliance matters.
• Leading and organizing the prioritization and remediation of Key Risk Indicators within the team.
• Building close relationships and an understanding with the relevant custodian stakeholders (Middle Office, Client Registrar, Risk & Compliance, etc.) and serving as their point of contact for the team.
• Ensuring that all telephone calls received by the team are dealt with.
• Helping with administrative tasks when required. Your profile
• Certification in Commerce/Banking, or an equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of 2–3 years’ experience as an assistant working in private banking.
• Service-oriented, with experience and understanding of dealing with private clients and assisting relationship managers.
• Understanding client documentation and the internal processes of a wealth management company
• Keen attention to detail.
• Able to work independently and diligently.
• Reliable and resilient with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task.
• Solution-oriented and with a proactive mindset.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
• Keen sense of ethics, values and partnership culture.
• Strong team spirit.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Must be resident in Switzerland. Start date: ASAP Ref: CRO/CC/JJV Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment.
